limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、package.json、src/index.ts、src/stock-tools.ts、src/stock-agent-contract.ts、src/stock-agent-service.ts、src/stock-tool-access.ts、src/stock-api/public-service.ts、src/stock-api/request-control.ts、src/client/StockMarketView.tsx、src/rpc.ts；9个业务工具验证action与参数，映射固定源适配器，按候选顺序回退并标记降级；会话日志驱动目录restrict、执行前policy与guard，侧栏走独立RPC。
limitations: 固定源码检查入口、9工具契约、代表查询及回退、会话访问、公开源请求控制、RPC缓存和侧栏刷新；未逐一审计全部57接口，未执行代码或实时行情任务。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 个人用户在DSH内获取公开证券资料并核对来源、时点和口径；不以插件查询成功替代交易或投资判断。
9个业务工具验证action与参数，映射固定源适配器，按候选顺序回退并标记降级；会话日志驱动目录restrict、执行前policy与guard，侧栏走独立RPC。
固定源码检查入口、9工具契约、代表查询及回退、会话访问、公开源请求控制、RPC缓存和侧栏刷新；未逐一审计全部57接口，未执行代码或实时行情任务。
v0.2.0 BSD-3-Clause，Node>=22.19，运行入口lib，源树需本地DSH工作区链接和构建；optional peer不等于运行可缺服务。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次使用 | 本地依赖/构建与宿主资源；金额未知 | 链接本地DSH工作区、构建、安装、确认兼容 | 无本轮安装耗时 |
| 持续使用 | 多类定时刷新、公共HTTP和模型工具输出 | 复核源、时间、降级及口径 | 模型token与网络量没有任务计量 |
| 失败恢复 | 排队、退避、换源或重新查询 | 区分取消/参数错误/上游失败及不可比数据 | 有限重试减少无界调用但不保证办结 |
资料查阅者可先限定小样本受控试用，与原来源核对时间和口径，检查会话关闭；降级无法解释或旧数据误导时停止依赖，不作为交易依据。详见[Q06](#research-q06)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 会话内查询 | 9工具组织多源业务动作 | 相对浏览器查询的净节时 |
| 调用面约束 | 固定参数/Host、响应和最终输出上限 | 真实宿主全部策略行为 |
| 降级透明 | source/attempted/degraded/warnings | 不同源同口径误差和实时性 |

侧栏5秒刷新不是所有资源统一频率，源码对指数、全球资产、成交额、资讯等分别设置间隔，并对休市和失败退避。RPC还有不同TTL缓存，获取时间可新而市场时间旧。业务工具超时与各供应商deadline也不同，排队/回退会影响最后能获得哪些结果。没有真实任务成功率、独立数据对照和人工时间，不给投资收益、成本节省或稳定性百分比。

会话级关闭有多层支持。最近一条stock-market/tool-access日志决定状态；禁用先安装agent.ctx.tools.restrict，再append事件，append失败会撤回新限制。执行前middleware和最终guard再次检查，能阻止旧请求里仍带的工具名称；恢复/新Agent创建时重建限制，销毁时释放。这比只隐藏按钮或只从下一次工具目录移除更完整，是可借鉴的策略分层。

边界是guard只对9个固定工具名且exec.agent存在的执行做会话判断，它不是整个进程或RPC的网络总开关。宿主需要正确提供Agent、tools.restrict和事件持久化语义，未核查实际固定宿主就不能写成已通过的权限保证。侧栏独立RPC与模型工具开关的范围也不同，用户关工具不意味着侧栏停止查行情。

网络有固定请求、拒绝重定向、并发/启动间隔、超时、有限重试和响应大小上限；这些约束资源和任意请求面，不证明公开接口有SLA或内容正确。fetched_at是获取时间，market_time可能缺失，两者不能互换。fallback只有成功响应时返回一次数据，不是多源交叉核验，degraded=false也不能推断与首选数值一致。新闻/研报为外部内容，模型需将其视为材料而非执行指令。本次没有复现权限绕过或数据错误。
把底层公开源收敛成9个业务工具，保留来源/回退/降级原因，并把会话工具目录限制与最终拒绝结合，减少任意URL拼接和只隐藏按钮的漏洞面。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。
回退成功不是多源核验，fetched_at不是行情时间，degraded也不证明口径可比；会话guard依赖真实Agent和宿主契约，公开源无稳定服务保证。详见[Q03](#research-q03)。
可探索按原问题时效/口径需求生成数据适用性收据，以固定陈旧、缺时间及跨复权样本比较误用与解释成本；未实现。详见[Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: novelty为成熟行情适配的小幅宿主集成；mechanism在固定业务面、降级契约与执行限制组合上有实质增量；transferability为持久会话开关分层策略的实质复用；simplification为众多适配器收敛9工具的实质接口简化，未将接口数量或未实现收据计入创新。

business.rationale: workflow将资料查询和模型会话集成有实质步骤变化；delivery仍是公开行情/资料小幅呈现改善；reach无需自行拼接口带来小幅门槛降低；economics没有经济结果或成本结构证据，取0不虚构收益。

recommendation.reason: 适合个人DSH用户受控试用公开资料查询，核对源、行情时间、口径和关闭策略；不作为交易依据或稳定数据服务保证。

scenario.rationale: 会话内行情与资料研究任务明确，但用户收益未测。

advantage.rationale: 固定业务工具、降级说明和持久会话开关相对手拼接口有较清晰优势。

evidence.rationale: 固定源码检查主链路和策略，未执行源/宿主，采用证据封顶50%。

cost.rationale: 免第三方凭据但依赖本地DSH工作区、构建和持续上游适配/复核。

# dsh-stock-market > 在DSH侧栏显示行情，并提供沪深A股快照、走势、排行、资金流、基本面、事件、研报和资讯工具。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[AnacondaKC/dsh-stock-market](https://github.com/AnacondaKC/dsh-stock-market) - **版本号**：0.2.0（[固定提交 02278af12330102c534c843a668d1c8407dbde1b](https://github.com/AnacondaKC/dsh-stock-market/tree/02278af12330102c534c843a668d1c8407dbde1b)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-13（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码支持固定接口治理、多源降级与会话访问分层贡献；实时性/口径和真实宿主行为未验收；数据适用性收据为未实现假设。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：个人用户在DSH内获取公开证券资料并核对来源、时点和口径；不以插件查询成功替代交易或投资判断。 - **亮点**：把底层公开源收敛成9个业务工具，保留来源/回退/降级原因，并把会话工具目录限制与最终拒绝结合，减少任意URL拼接和只隐藏按钮的漏洞面。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **思考**：回退成功不是多源核验，fetched_at不是行情时间，degraded也不证明口径可比；会话guard依赖真实Agent和宿主契约，公开源无稳定服务保证。详见[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：可探索按原问题时效/口径需求生成数据适用性收据，以固定陈旧、缺时间及跨复权样本比较误用与解释成本；未实现。详见[Q06](#research-q06)。 采用建议：资料查阅者可先限定小样本受控试用，与原来源核对时间和口径，检查会话关闭；降级无法解释或旧数据误导时停止依赖，不作为交易依据。详见[Q06](#research-q06)。 ## 核心贡献 把底层公开源收敛成9个业务工具，保留来源/回退/降级原因，并把会话工具目录限制与最终拒绝结合，减少任意URL拼接和只隐藏按钮的漏洞面。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 关键质疑 回退成功不是多源核验，fetched_at不是行情时间，degraded也不证明口径可比；会话guard依赖真实Agent和宿主契约，公开源无稳定服务保证。详见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 可探索按原问题时效/口径需求生成数据适用性收据，以固定陈旧、缺时间及跨复权样本比较误用与解释成本；未实现。详见[Q06](#research-q06)。 进一步探讨可从同证券同交易时点不同源/复权样本核对适用性，并以跨会话、恢复和过期请求验证关闭策略。 ## 场景与替代办法 个人用户在DSH内获取公开证券资料并核对来源、时点和口径；不以插件查询成功替代交易或投资判断。 财经网站查询或自行编写固定接口脚本为直接参照；插件增加DSH会话内工具与侧栏，不能代替原始数据核验。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Node>=22.19、Cordis及DSH peer接口 | 包声明必需 | 宿主插件、工具和RPC | optional peer表示安装层非硬依赖，不等于运行可无接口 | | agents/connection/tools及settings | 入口与分支必需 | 工具注册、会话状态和配置 | 注入不满足会影响对应接线 | | web客户端布局/设置/slots等包 | 侧栏需要 | 行情、会话开关与配置UI | 不能仅靠宿主工具证明UI可用 | | 本地DSH工作区与构建工具 | 源码安装需要 | 链接peer并构建lib | README不把公共npm依赖当完整构建来源 | | 外网访问固定财经Host | 行情操作需要 | 公开数据请求 | 无凭据不等于无网络和限流 | | 合法会话和证券参数 | 工具操作需要 | 沪深A股范围查询 | 未声明action/URL等自由输入拒绝 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 用户确认固定源码、DSH工作区和构建产物 | 不把README安装行当已可直接加载源码 | | 加载 | 构建校验后link安装到web profile | 宿主工具、RPC和侧栏分别可用 | | 控制 | 按会话开关工具，核对日志恢复与目录限制 | 工具关闭后旧调用应受guard检查 | | 查阅 | 核对来源、market_time与degraded | 缺失/降级时回来源复核 | | 恢复 | 源失败接受有限回退或等待，退出用插件设置 | 不反复新会话或高频重试绕过上游约束 | 当前enabled=false保留配置RPC，便于重新打开，不代表所有网络能力被彻底卸载。源码build到lib的产物与实际安装包应另核对，本轮不运行build、live烟测或宿主。 ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次使用 | 本地依赖/构建与宿主资源；金额未知 | 链接本地DSH工作区、构建、安装、确认兼容 | 无本轮安装耗时 | | 持续使用 | 多类定时刷新、公共HTTP和模型工具输出 | 复核源、时间、降级及口径 | 模型token与网络量没有任务计量 | | 失败恢复 | 排队、退避、换源或重新查询 | 区分取消/参数错误/上游失败及不可比数据 | 有限重试减少无界调用但不保证办结 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 会话内查询 | 9工具组织多源业务动作 | 相对浏览器查询的净节时 | | 调用面约束 | 固定参数/Host、响应和最终输出上限 | 真实宿主全部策略行为 | | 降级透明 | source/attempted/degraded/warnings | 不同源同口径误差和实时性 | 侧栏5秒刷新不是所有资源统一频率，源码对指数、全球资产、成交额、资讯等分别设置间隔，并对休市和失败退避。RPC还有不同TTL缓存，获取时间可新而市场时间旧。业务工具超时与各供应商deadline也不同，排队/回退会影响最后能获得哪些结果。没有真实任务成功率、独立数据对照和人工时间，不给投资收益、成本节省或稳定性百分比。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**判断固定版本沪深行情插件的接口治理、会话控制与资料查阅价值。 ### Q01 · 谁使用行情侧栏，合格数据结果是什么？ **研究主题：**场景与需求 #### 完整回答 面向在DSH内查看沪深A股公开行情、做资料整理和模型辅助研究的个人用户。插件提供行情侧栏与9个业务工具，查询快照、K线、排行、资金流、基本面、公告、研报、资讯和能力口径。侧栏还显示部分全球资产，不应把界面覆盖直接解释成工具支持全球证券。 合格的数据结果应有明确证券代码、来源、数据时间与获取时间、范围/复权/排序等口径，以及是否使用备用源和降级警告。一次接口返回JSON或模型生成分析不代表资料完整，更不代表投资结论正确。原有办法是访问财经网站或写接口脚本，插件增加会话内结构化查询与可控工具开关，没有下单或交易执行链。 用途是数据查阅与研究辅助，不将公开网站接口可访问性解释成正式数据授权、实时性保证或交易依据。本轮只研究固定源码，不获取当前市场事实，也不评价任何证券。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:3-10](https://github.com/AnacondaKC/dsh-stock-market/blob/02278af12330102c534c843a668d1c8407dbde1b/README.md#L3-L10) 作者定位侧栏、免费工具与会话开关。 ```text DSH 的沪深 A 股行情侧栏和固定免费股票数据工具插件。 ## ### Q03 · 会话关闭、网络和输出控制可信吗，可复用什么？ **研究主题：**缺陷与关键质疑、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 会话级关闭有多层支持。最近一条stock-market/tool-access日志决定状态；禁用先安装agent.ctx.tools.restrict，再append事件，append失败会撤回新限制。执行前middleware和最终guard再次检查，能阻止旧请求里仍带的工具名称；恢复/新Agent创建时重建限制，销毁时释放。这比只隐藏按钮或只从下一次工具目录移除更完整，是可借鉴的策略分层。 边界是guard只对9个固定工具名且exec.agent存在的执行做会话判断，它不是整个进程或RPC的网络总开关。宿主需要正确提供Agent、tools.restrict和事件持久化语义，未核查实际固定宿主就不能写成已通过的权限保证。侧栏独立RPC与模型工具开关的范围也不同，用户关工具不意味着侧栏停止查行情。 网络有固定请求、拒绝重定向、并发/启动间隔、超时、有限重试和响应大小上限；这些约束资源和任意请求面，不证明公开接口有SLA或内容正确。fetched_at是获取时间，market_time可能缺失，两者不能互换。fallback只有成功响应时返回一次数据，不是多源交叉核验，degraded=false也不能推断与首选数值一致。新闻/研报为外部内容，模型需将其视为材料而非执行指令。本次没有复现权限绕过或数据错误。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/stock-tool-access.ts:45-54](https://github.com/AnacondaKC/dsh-stock-market/blob/02278af12330102c534c843a668d1c8407dbde1b/src/stock-tool-access.ts#L45-L54) 目录限制、pre-execute及最终guard组合。

      "content": "# dsh-stock-market

DSH 的沪深 A 股行情侧栏和固定免费股票数据工具插件。

## 功能

- 右侧“行情”侧栏：顶部信息区展示上证指数、恒生指数、纳斯达克、韩国综合、日经指数、布伦特原油和纽约金主连的最新价与涨跌，支持横向滚动；侧栏支持收起、拖拽或键盘调整宽度及会话级状态保存。
- A 股行情快照：上证指数、深证成指、创业板指和科创综指来自腾讯实时行情，5 秒刷新；两市成交额与上一交易日同期比较，财经资讯来自东方财富。
- 数据接口设置：展示全部免费数据源和已接入的固定接口目录，无需配置凭据。
- 会话级股票工具开关：输入框工具行可启用或关闭全部股票工具，状态随会话日志持久化。

## 界面预览

![行情侧栏与股票工具开关](assets/screenshots/stock-market-overview.png)

![股票分析会话与行情侧栏](assets/screenshots/stock-market-analysis.png)

![股票分析结果与收起后的行情侧栏](assets/screenshots/stock-market-report.png)

## 接口目录

| 数据源 | 接口数 | 主要能力 |
|---|---:|---|
| 东方财富 | 36 | 实时/批量行情、排行、K 线、分时、资金流、数据中心、F10、研报、资讯、搜索 |
| 腾讯财经 | 6 | 批量实时行情、K 线、分时、个股/板块排行、个股资讯 |
| 新浪财经 | 13 | 批量实时行情、K 线、市场/板块、资金流、滚动新闻及页面型数据 |
| 同花顺 | 2 | 日 K、分时走势 |

只保留无需许可证、API Key、Cookie 或登录状态即可调用的免费接口。不可无状态调用或已经停服的接口不接入插件。

## DSH 工具

Agent 只看到以下 9 个按业务组织的工具，57 个数据源接口保留为插件内部适配器：

- `stock_quote`：实时证券行情快照。
- `stock_chart`：K 线与分时走势。
- `stock_ranking`：个股、行业、概念和板块成分排行。
- `stock_money_flow`：个股、板块及沪深港通资金流。
- `stock_fundamentals`：公司、财务、股东、估值和经营指标。
- `stock_events`：公告、大宗交易、融资融券、龙虎榜和数据中心事件。
- `stock_research`：市场研报、个股研报、盈利预测和评级。
- `stock_news`：资讯流、个股新闻、搜索和股吧。
- `stock_capabilities`：查询工具动作、参数及数据源切换口径。

证券代码统一使用 `600519.SH` 或 `000001.SZ`，仅支持沪深 A 股。各工具只接受声明的 `action` 及对应业务参数，不接受底层 `endpoint_id`、URL、Host、代理地址或凭据。默认 `source=auto`：语义等价的接口可自动切换；排行、资金流和页面型资讯存在口径差异时，返回值会标记 `degraded` 并附警告。侧栏继续使用独立、稳定的内部 RPC 契约。

## 安全与稳定性

- 插件不读取或存储任何第三方行情凭据。
- 输入框开关关闭后，全部 `stock_*` 工具会从该会话下一次模型请求的工具目录中移除；旧请求或伪造调用仍会被执行前策略和最终 guard 拒绝。
- 外部数据工具经 DSH 的统一执行策略处理。
- 所有公开网站请求使用固定 Host、参数白名单和固定 Referer；腾讯、新浪、同花顺的 GBK 数据只在服务端解码。
- 请求包含连接并发限制、文档建议的最小启动间隔、超时、有限退避重试、取消传播和 8 MiB 响应上限。
- JSON 数组、长文本、HTML 页面和最终工具 JSON 都有独立输出上限，避免把超大上游响应直接送入浏览器或模型上下文。
- 这些公开网站接口没有正式 SLA，可能随上游改版失效；商业或高频使用应采用正式授权数据源。

## 开发与发布

本插件的 DSH 依赖来自本地 DSH 工作区，不从公共 npm 获取。首次安装依赖后，设置 `DSH_WORKSPACE_ROOT` 并执行工作区链接：

```bash
npm ci --include=dev
DSH_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/dsh-workspace npm run setup:dsh-workspace
```

本仓库旁的 `../docs/test-AnacondaKC` 是默认工作区路径。链接脚本不会替换已有的非链接依赖。

```bash
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm run verify:package
```

`npm run build` 会先构建到同文件系统的暂存目录、验证产物和清单，然后以原子交换方式提升为 `lib/`；在不支持原子交换的平台上会使用可回滚的提升流程。`prepack` 会执行完整离线质量门禁并校验实际 `.tgz` 解包内容。

真实公开源烟测默认关闭，避免常规测试依赖网络：

```bash
DSH_STOCK_MARKET_LIVE_SMOKE=1 npm run test:live
```

东方财富固定目录的源文件位于 `scripts/catalog-sources/eastmoney.py`。修改后重新生成：

```bash
python3 scripts/generate-stock-api-catalog.py
```

调研文档新增的公开网站目录维护在 `src/stock-api/researched-catalog.ts`，不会被上述生成脚本覆盖。

dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-stock-market

import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
import { registerStockMarketConfig } from './plugin-config-service.ts'
import { registerStockMarketRpc } from './rpc.ts'
import type { StockMarketPluginConfig } from './rpc-contract.ts'
import { StockApiService } from './stock-api/service.ts'
import { StockToolAccessService } from './stock-tool-access.ts'
import { registerStockMarketTools } from './stock-tools.ts'

export const name = 'dsh-stock-market'
export const inject = ['agents', 'connection', 'tools']

export const Config: z<StockMarketPluginConfig> = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean().default(true),
  sidebarOpenByDefault: z.boolean().default(true),
  toolsEnabledByDefault: z.boolean().default(true),
})

export function apply(ctx: Context, config: StockMarketPluginConfig): void {
  ctx.inject(['settings'], (settingsCtx) => {
    const configScope = registerStockMarketConfig(settingsCtx.settings, config)
    const effective = configScope.get()

    // The RPC channel is always mounted so the browser config card stays
    // reachable while the plugin is disabled — otherwise the master switch
    // would lock the plugin off with no UI path back (only YAML edits).
    const stockApi = new StockApiService()
    let toolAccess: StockToolAccessService | undefined
    if (effective.enabled) {
      registerStockMarketTools(ctx, stockApi)
      toolAccess = new StockToolAccessService(ctx as never, effective.toolsEnabledByDefault)
    }
    ctx.effect(() => registerStockMarketRpc(ctx.connection, {
      stockApiService: stockApi,
      toolAccess,
      config,
      configScope,
      enabled: effective.enabled,
    }), 'dsh-stock-market: RPC channel')
  })
}

function symbolSchema() {
  return {
    type: 'string' as const,
    description: '标准沪深 A 股代码，如 600519.SH 或 000001.SZ。',
  }
}

function pageSchema() {
  return { type: 'integer' as const, description: '页码，从 1 开始，默认 1，最多 100。' }
}

function pageSizeSchema() {
  return { type: 'integer' as const, description: '每页完整记录数，默认按动作确定，最多 50。' }
}

function orderSchema() {
  return { type: 'string' as const, enum: ['asc', 'desc'] as const, description: '升序或降序，默认 desc。' }
}

function jsonOutput() {
  return {
    schema: { type: 'string' as const },
    render: (_args: unknown, value: string) => [{ type: 'text' as const, text: value }],
  }
}

function stringify(value: unknown): string {
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(value)
  if (serialized.length <= MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARACTERS) return serialized

  const record = isRecord(value) ? value : {}
  const warnings = Array.isArray(record.warnings)
    ? record.warnings.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string').slice(0, 10)
    : []
  const bounded = JSON.stringify({
    ...record,
    data: {
      omitted: true,
      reason: '响应超过工具 64k 字符上限，请减小 limit、缩小日期范围或按页查询。',
    },
    warnings: [...warnings, '完整数据因工具输出上限被省略。'],
    output_truncated: true,
    original_characters: serialized.length,
  })
  if (bounded.length <= MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARACTERS) return bounded
  return JSON.stringify({
    output_truncated: true,
    original_characters: serialized.length,
    error: '响应超过工具 64k 字符上限，请缩小查询范围。',
  })
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

import { StockApiError } from './stock-api/errors.ts'

import {

const PROVIDERS = ['eastmoney', 'tencent', 'sina', 'tonghuashun'] as const
const SOURCES = ['auto', ...PROVIDERS] as const
const KLINE_PERIODS = ['1m', '5m', '15m', '30m', '60m', 'day', 'week', 'month'] as const
const ADJUSTMENTS = ['none', 'qfq', 'hfq'] as const
const RANKING_SORTS = ['price', 'change_percent', 'volume', 'amount', 'turnover_rate', 'net_inflow'] as const
const MARKETS = ['all_a', 'sh_a', 'sz_a', 'chinext', 'star'] as const
const SECTOR_TYPES = ['industry', 'concept'] as const
const MAX_PAGE = 100
const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50
const MAX_KLINE_ITEMS = 300
const MAX_INTRADAY_ITEMS = 300
const MAX_QUOTE_SYMBOLS = 60

export interface StockAgentResult {
  readonly action: string
  readonly source: StockDataProvider | 'internal'
  readonly attempted_sources: readonly StockDataProvider[]
  readonly fallback_used: boolean
  readonly degraded: boolean
  readonly fetched_at: string
  readonly data: StockApiJson
  readonly warnings: readonly string[]
}

interface CanonicalSymbol {
  readonly canonical: string
  readonly code: string
  readonly market: 'SH' | 'SZ'
}

interface Candidate {
  readonly provider: StockDataProvider
  readonly endpointId: string
  readonly parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>
  readonly normalize: (value: StockApiJson) => StockApiJson
  readonly degraded?: boolean
  readonly warning?: string
}

interface AggregateRequest {
  readonly key: string
  readonly endpointId: string
  readonly parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>
}

type SourceChoice = typeof SOURCES[number]
type JsonRecord = Record<string, StockApiJson>

export class StockAgentService {
  constructor(
    private readonly api: StockApiService,
    private readonly now: () => Date = () => new Date(),
  ) {}

  async execute(tool: StockAgentToolName, input: unknown, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const args = requireRecord(input)
    switch (tool) {
      case 'stock_quote': return this.executeQuote(args, signal)
      case 'stock_chart': return this.executeChart(args, signal)
      case 'stock_ranking': return this.executeRanking(args, signal)
      case 'stock_money_flow': return this.executeMoneyFlow(args, signal)
      case 'stock_fundamentals': return this.executeFundamentals(args, signal)
      case 'stock_events': return this.executeEvents(args, signal)
      case 'stock_research': return this.executeResearch(args, signal)
      case 'stock_news': return this.executeNews(args, signal)
      case 'stock_capabilities': return this.executeCapabilities(args)
    }
  }

  private async executeQuote(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const action = requiredEnum(args, 'action', ['snapshot'] as const)
    assertAllowed(args, action, ['symbols', 'detail', 'source'])
    const symbols = symbolArray(args, 'symbols', MAX_QUOTE_SYMBOLS)
    const detail = optionalEnum(args, 'detail', ['basic', 'full'] as const, 'basic')
    if (detail === 'full' && symbols.length > 20) {
      throw badRequest('stock_quote.snapshot 在 detail=full 时最多接受 20 个证券代码。')
    }
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    const candidates: Candidate[] = []
    const tencentSymbols = symbols.map(toTencentSymbol)
    candidates.push({
      provider: 'tencent',
      endpointId: 'tx_realtime_quotes',
      parameters: { symbols: tencentSymbols.join(',') },
      normalize: value => normalizeQuotes('tencent', value, symbols, detail),
    })
    const endpointId = symbols.length === 1 && detail === 'full' ? 'em_realtime_quote' : 'em_batch_quotes'
    candidates.push({
      provider: 'eastmoney',
      endpointId,
      parameters: endpointId === 'em_realtime_quote'
        ? { secid: toEastMoneySecid(symbols[0]) }
        : { secids: symbols.map(toEastMoneySecid).join(',') },
      normalize: value => normalizeQuotes('eastmoney', value, symbols, detail),
      degraded: detail === 'full' && endpointId === 'em_batch_quotes',
      warning: detail === 'full' && endpointId === 'em_batch_quotes'
        ? '东方财富批量备用路径不提供完整的开高低和换手率字段。'
        : undefined,
    })
    candidates.push({
      provider: 'sina',
      endpointId: 'sina_realtime_quotes',
      parameters: { symbols: symbols.map(toSinaSymbol).join(',') },
      normalize: value => normalizeQuotes('sina', value, symbols, detail),
    })
    return this.runCandidates('snapshot', source, candidates, signal)
  }

  private async executeChart(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const action = requiredEnum(args, 'action', ['kline', 'intraday'] as const)
    if (action === 'kline') return this.executeKline(args, signal)
    return this.executeIntraday(args, signal)
  }

  private async executeKline(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'kline', ['symbol', 'period', 'adjust', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'limit', 'source'])
    const symbol = symbolArg(args)
    const period = optionalEnum(args, 'period', KLINE_PERIODS, 'day')
    const adjust = optionalEnum(args, 'adjust', ADJUSTMENTS, 'qfq')
    const startDate = optionalDate(args, 'start_date')
    const endDate = optionalDate(args, 'end_date')
    if (startDate !== undefined && endDate !== undefined && startDate > endDate) {
      throw badRequest('start_date 不能晚于 end_date。')
    }
    const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 120, 1, MAX_KLINE_ITEMS)
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    const candidates: Candidate[] = []

    candidates.push({
      provider: 'eastmoney',
      endpointId: 'em_price_history',
      parameters: {
        secid: toEastMoneySecid(symbol),
        period,
        adjust,
        begin: compactDate(startDate ?? '1990-01-01'),
        end: compactDate(endDate ?? '2050-01-01'),
        limit,
      },
      normalize: value => normalizeKline('eastmoney', value, symbol, period, adjust, limit),
    })

    if (period !== '1m') {
      const tencentPeriod = period.startsWith('m') ? period : period === 'day' || period === 'week' || period === 'month'
        ? period
        : `m${period.slice(0, -1)}`
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tencent',
        endpointId: 'tx_price_history',
        parameters: {
          symbol: toTencentSymbol(symbol),
          period: tencentPeriod,
          ...(startDate === undefined ? {} : { start: startDate }),
          ...(endDate === undefined ? {} : { end: endDate }),
          limit,
          adjust,
        },
        normalize: value => normalizeKline('tencent', value, symbol, period, adjust, limit),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '腾讯 K 线不提供成交额，amount 返回 null。',
      })
    }

    if (
      period !== '1m'
      && adjust === 'none'
      && startDate === undefined
      && endDate === undefined
    ) {
      const scale = sinaScale(period)
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'sina',
        endpointId: period.endsWith('m') ? 'sina_intraday_kline' : 'sina_price_history',
        parameters: { symbol: toSinaSymbol(symbol), scale, limit },
        normalize: value => normalizeKline('sina', value, symbol, period, adjust, limit),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '新浪 K 线成交量口径与首选源可能不同。',
      })
    }

    if (
      period === 'day'
      && adjust === 'none'
      && startDate === undefined
      && endDate === undefined
    ) {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tonghuashun',
        endpointId: 'ths_price_history',
        parameters: { symbol: toTonghuashunSymbol(symbol), archive: 'last' },
        normalize: value => normalizeKline('tonghuashun', value, symbol, period, adjust, limit),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '同花顺日 K 为页面归档口径，成交量字段可能与首选源不同。',
      })
    }
    return this.runCandidates('kline', source, candidates, signal)
  }

  private async executeIntraday(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'intraday', ['symbol', 'days', 'limit', 'source'])
    const symbol = symbolArg(args)
    const days = optionalEnum(args, 'days', [1, 5] as const, 1)
    const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 120, 1, MAX_INTRADAY_ITEMS)
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    const candidates: Candidate[] = []
    candidates.push({
      provider: 'eastmoney',
      endpointId: 'em_intraday_trends',
      parameters: { secid: toEastMoneySecid(symbol), days },
      normalize: value => normalizeIntraday('eastmoney', value, symbol, days, limit),
    })
    if (days === 1) {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tencent',
        endpointId: 'tx_intraday_trends',
        parameters: { symbol: toTencentSymbol(symbol) },
        normalize: value => normalizeIntraday('tencent', value, symbol, days, limit),
      })
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tonghuashun',
        endpointId: 'ths_intraday_trends',
        parameters: { symbol: toTonghuashunSymbol(symbol) },
        normalize: value => normalizeIntraday('tonghuashun', value, symbol, days, limit),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '同花顺分时成交字段采用页面累计口径。',
      })
    }
    return this.runCandidates('intraday', source, candidates, signal)
  }

  private async executeRanking(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const action = requiredEnum(args, 'action', ['stocks', 'sectors', 'sector_members', 'sector_catalog'] as const)
    if (action === 'stocks') return this.executeStockRanking(args, signal)
    if (action === 'sectors') return this.executeSectorRanking(args, signal)
    if (action === 'sector_members') return this.executeSectorMembers(args, signal)
    return this.executeSectorCatalog(args, signal)
  }

  private async executeStockRanking(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'stocks', ['market', 'sort', 'order', 'page', 'limit', 'source'])
    const market = optionalEnum(args, 'market', MARKETS, 'all_a')
    const sort = optionalEnum(args, 'sort', RANKING_SORTS, 'change_percent')
    const order = optionalEnum(args, 'order', ['asc', 'desc'] as const, 'desc')
    const page = optionalInteger(args, 'page', 1, 1, MAX_PAGE)
    const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 20, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    const candidates: Candidate[] = [{
      provider: 'eastmoney',
      endpointId: 'em_market_snapshot',
      parameters: { market, sort, order, page, limit },
      normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, false),
    }]
    const txSort = tencentRankingSort(sort)
    if (market === 'all_a' && txSort !== undefined) {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tencent',
        endpointId: 'tx_stock_rank',
        parameters: { sort: txSort, order, offset: (page - 1) * limit, limit },
        normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, false),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '腾讯排行的市场范围和指标口径可能与东方财富不同。',
      })
    }
    const sinaSort = sinaRankingSort(sort)
    if (sinaSort !== undefined) {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'sina',
        endpointId: 'sina_market_snapshot',
        parameters: { node: sinaMarketNode(market), page, limit, sort: sinaSort, order },
        normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, false),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '新浪排行的市场筛选和指标口径可能与东方财富不同。',
      })
    }
    return this.runCandidates('stocks', source, candidates, signal)
  }

  private async executeSectorRanking(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'sectors', ['sector_type', 'sort', 'order', 'page', 'limit', 'source'])
    const sectorType = optionalEnum(args, 'sector_type', SECTOR_TYPES, 'industry')
    const sort = optionalEnum(args, 'sort', RANKING_SORTS, 'change_percent')
    const order = optionalEnum(args, 'order', ['asc', 'desc'] as const, 'desc')
    const page = optionalInteger(args, 'page', 1, 1, MAX_PAGE)
    const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 20, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    const candidates: Candidate[] = [{
      provider: 'eastmoney',
      endpointId: 'em_market_snapshot',
      parameters: { market: sectorType, sort, order, page, limit },
      normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, true),
    }]
    if (sort === 'price' || sort === 'change_percent') {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'tencent',
        endpointId: 'tx_sector_rank',
        parameters: { sector_type: sectorType, sort: 'price', order, offset: (page - 1) * limit, limit },
        normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, true),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '腾讯板块排行仅提供已验证的 price 排序，板块口径可能不同。',
      })
    }
    if (sectorType === 'industry') {
      candidates.push({
        provider: 'sina',
        endpointId: 'sina_industry_overview',
        parameters: {},
        normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, true, true),
        degraded: true,
        warning: '新浪行业分类及统计口径可能与东方财富不同。',
      })
    }
    return this.runCandidates('sectors', source, candidates, signal)
  }

  private async executeSectorMembers(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'sector_members', ['sector_id', 'sort', 'order', 'page', 'limit', 'source'])
    const sectorId = requiredString(args, 'sector_id', /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}$/u)
    const sort = optionalEnum(args, 'sort', RANKING_SORTS, 'change_percent')
    const sinaSort = sinaRankingSort(sort)
    if (sinaSort === undefined) throw badRequest(`stock_ranking.sector_members 不支持 sort=${sort}。`)
    const order = optionalEnum(args, 'order', ['asc', 'desc'] as const, 'desc')
    const page = optionalInteger(args, 'page', 1, 1, MAX_PAGE)
    const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 20, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    return this.runCandidates('sector_members', source, [{
      provider: 'sina',
      endpointId: 'sina_market_snapshot',
      parameters: { node: sectorId, page, limit, sort: sinaSort, order },
      normalize: value => normalizeRanking(value, page, limit, order, sort, false),
    }], signal)
  }

  private async executeSectorCatalog(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    assertAllowed(args, 'sector_catalog', ['sector_type', 'source'])
    const sectorType = optionalEnum(args, 'sector_type', SECTOR_TYPES, 'industry')
    const source = sourceArg(args)
    return this.runCandidates('sector_catalog', source, [{
      provider: 'sina',
      endpointId: sectorType === 'industry' ? 'sina_industry_catalog' : 'sina_concept_catalog',
      parameters: {},
      normalize: value => normalizeSectorCatalog(value, sectorType),
    }], signal)
  }

  private async executeMoneyFlow(args: Record<string, unknown>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const action = requiredEnum(args, 'action', ['stock_history', 'stock_intraday', 'sector', 'connect'] as const)
    if (action === 'stock_history') {
      assertAllowed(args, action, ['symbol', 'page', 'limit', 'source'])
      const symbol = symbolArg(args)
      const page = optionalInteger(args, 'page', 1, 1, 20)
      const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 20, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
      const source = sourceArg(args)
      return this.runCandidates(action, source, [
        {
          provider: 'eastmoney', endpointId: 'em_money_flow_history',
          parameters: { secid: toEastMoneySecid(symbol), limit: page * limit },
          normalize: value => normalizeMoneyFlow(value, symbol, page, limit),
        },
        {
          provider: 'sina', endpointId: 'sina_stock_money_flow',
          parameters: { symbol: toSinaSymbol(symbol), page, limit },
          normalize: value => normalizeMoneyFlow(value, symbol, page, limit),
          degraded: true,
          warning: '新浪个股资金流的资金分类口径可能与东方财富不同。',
        },
      ], signal)
    }
    if (action === 'stock_intraday') {
      assertAllowed(args, action, ['symbol', 'limit', 'source'])
      const symbol = symbolArg(args)
      const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 120, 1, MAX_INTRADAY_ITEMS)
      const source = sourceArg(args)
      return this.runCandidates(action, source, [{
        provider: 'eastmoney', endpointId: 'em_money_flow_intraday',
        parameters: { secid: toEastMoneySecid(symbol), limit },
        normalize: value => normalizeMoneyFlow(value, symbol, 1, limit),
      }], signal)
    }
    if (action === 'sector') {
      assertAllowed(args, action, ['sector_type', 'page', 'limit', 'source'])
      const sectorType = optionalEnum(args, 'sector_type', SECTOR_TYPES, 'industry')
      const page = optionalInteger(args, 'page', 1, 1, MAX_PAGE)
      const limit = optionalInteger(args, 'limit', 20, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)
      const source = sourceArg(args)
      return this.runCandidates(action, source, [
        {

          degraded: true,
          warning: '新浪板块分类和资金统计口径可能与东方财富不同。',
        },
      ], signal)
    }

    assertAllowed(args, action, ['direction', 'limit', 'source'])
    const direction = optionalEnum(args, 'direction', ['all', 'northbound', 'southbound'] as const, 'all')

  private executeCapabilities(args: Record<string, unknown>): StockAgentResult {
    const action = requiredEnum(args, 'action', ['list', 'describe', 'sources'] as const)
    const interfaceCount = EASTMONEY_ENDPOINTS.length + TENCENT_ENDPOINTS.length + SINA_ENDPOINTS.length + TONGHUASHUN_ENDPOINTS.length
    let data: StockApiJson
    if (action === 'list') {
      assertAllowed(args, action, ['tool'])
      const tool = optionalString(args, 'tool')
      if (tool === undefined) {
        data = {
          tool_count: STOCK_TOOL_CAPABILITIES.length,
          internal_interface_count: interfaceCount,
          tools: STOCK_TOOL_CAPABILITIES.map(item => ({
            name: item.name,
            summary: item.summary,
            actions: item.actions.map(candidate => candidate.name),
          })),
        }
      } else {
        const capability = requireCapability(tool)
        data = {
          name: capability.name,
          summary: capability.summary,
          actions: capability.actions.map(candidate => ({ name: candidate.name, summary: candidate.summary })),
        }
      }
    } else {
      assertAllowed(args, action, ['tool', 'target_action'])
      const capability = requireCapability(requiredString(args, 'tool'))
      const targetAction = optionalString(args, 'target_action')
      if (action === 'sources' && targetAction === undefined) {
        throw badRequest('stock_capabilities.sources 必须提供 target_action。')
      }
      const actions = targetAction === undefined
        ? capability.actions
        : [requireCapabilityAction(capability, targetAction)]
      data = action === 'describe'
        ? {
            name: capability.name,
            summary: capability.summary,
            actions: actions.map(candidate => ({
              name: candidate.name,
              summary: candidate.summary,
              parameters: [...candidate.parameters],
            })),
          }
        : {
            tool: capability.name,
            actions: actions.map(candidate => ({
              name: candidate.name,
              sources: [...candidate.sources],
              fallback: candidate.fallback,
              fallback_note: fallbackNote(candidate.fallback),
            })),
          }
    }
    return {
      action,
      source: 'internal',
      attempted_sources: [],
      fallback_used: false,
      degraded: false,
      fetched_at: this.now().toISOString(),
      data,
      warnings: [],
    }
  }

  private async runSingleEastMoney(
    action: string,
    endpointId: string,
    parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>,
    signal: AbortSignal,
    normalize: (value: StockApiJson) => StockApiJson = value => value,
    degraded = false,
    warning?: string,
  ): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    return this.runCandidates(action, 'auto', [{
      provider: 'eastmoney', endpointId, parameters, normalize, degraded, warning,
    }], signal)
  }

  private async runEastMoneyAggregate(
    action: string,
    requests: readonly AggregateRequest[],
    signal: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const outcomes = await Promise.allSettled(requests.map(request => (
      this.api.executeEastMoney(request.endpointId, request.parameters, signal)
    )))
    if (signal.aborted) throw new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled')
    const data: JsonRecord = {}
    const unavailable: string[] = []
    const fetchedAt: string[] = []
    for (const [index, outcome] of outcomes.entries()) {
      const request = requests[index]
      if (outcome.status === 'fulfilled') {
        data[request.key] = outcome.value.data
        fetchedAt.push(outcome.value.fetchedAt)
      } else {
        if (isFatalError(outcome.reason) || !isFallbackError(outcome.reason)) throw outcome.reason
        unavailable.push(request.key)
      }
    }
    if (fetchedAt.length === 0) throw new StockApiError(`${action} 的免费数据源暂时不可用。`, 'unavailable')
    return {
      action,
      source: 'eastmoney',
      attempted_sources: ['eastmoney'],
      fallback_used: false,
      degraded: unavailable.length > 0,
      fetched_at: fetchedAt.sort().at(-1) ?? this.now().toISOString(),
      data: { ...data, unavailable_sections: unavailable },
      warnings: unavailable.length === 0 ? [] : [`部分数据暂不可用：${unavailable.join('、')}。`],
    }
  }

  private async runCandidates(
    action: string,
    source: SourceChoice,
    candidates: readonly Candidate[],
    signal: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<StockAgentResult> {
    const selected = source === 'auto' ? candidates : candidates.filter(candidate => candidate.provider === source)
    if (selected.length === 0) {
      throw badRequest(`${action} 不支持 source=${source} 或当前参数组合。`)
    }
    const attempted: StockDataProvider[] = []
    let failures = 0
    let previousProvider: StockDataProvider | undefined
    let lastFallbackError: StockApiError | undefined
    for (const candidate of selected) {
      if (!attempted.includes(candidate.provider)) attempted.push(candidate.provider)
      try {
        const response = await this.executeCandidate(candidate, signal)
        const data = candidate.normalize(response.data)
        const fallbackUsed = failures > 0
        const warnings: string[] = []
        if (fallbackUsed) {
          warnings.push(previousProvider === candidate.provider
            ? `首选数据适配路径不可用，已使用 ${providerLabel(candidate.provider)} 的备用路径。`
            : `首选免费数据源不可用，已切换至 ${providerLabel(candidate.provider)}。`)
        }
        if (candidate.warning !== undefined) warnings.push(candidate.warning)
        return {
          action,
          source: response.provider,
          attempted_sources: attempted,
          fallback_used: fallbackUsed,
          degraded: candidate.degraded === true,
          fetched_at: response.fetchedAt,
          data,
          warnings,
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (isFatalError(error) || !isFallbackError(error)) throw error
        failures++
        previousProvider = candidate.provider
        lastFallbackError = error
      }
    }
    if (source !== 'auto' && lastFallbackError !== undefined) throw lastFallbackError
    throw new StockApiError(`${action} 的免费数据源暂时不可用。`, 'unavailable')
  }

  private executeCandidate(candidate: Candidate, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<StockApiResult> {
    switch (candidate.provider) {
      case 'eastmoney': return this.api.executeEastMoney(candidate.endpointId, candidate.parameters, signal)
      case 'tencent': return this.api.executeTencent(candidate.endpointId, candidate.parameters, signal)
      case 'sina': return this.api.executeSina(candidate.endpointId, candidate.parameters, signal)
      case 'tonghuashun': return this.api.executeTonghuashun(candidate.endpointId, candidate.parameters, signal)
    }
  }
}

function normalizeQuotes(
  provider: StockDataProvider,
  value: StockApiJson,
  requested: readonly CanonicalSymbol[],
  detail: 'basic' | 'full',
): StockApiJson {
  const root = asRecord(value)
  let rows: readonly StockApiJson[] | undefined
  if (provider === 'eastmoney') {
    const data = asRecord(root?.data)
    rows = Array.isArray(data?.diff) ? data.diff : data === undefined ? undefined : [data]
  } else {
    rows = Array.isArray(root?.quotes) ? root.quotes : undefined
  }
  if (rows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('实时行情')

  const quotes: StockApiJson[] = []
  const returned = new Set<string>()
  for (const item of rows) {
    const row = asRecord(item)
    if (row === undefined) continue
    const symbol = matchRequestedSymbol(provider, row, requested)
    if (symbol === undefined || returned.has(symbol.canonical)) continue
    const price = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(row.f43 ?? row.f2)
      : numberOrNull(row.price)
    const previousClose = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(row.f60 ?? row.f18)
      : numberOrNull(row.previous_close)
    const change = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(row.f169 ?? row.f4)
      : numberOrNull(row.change)
    const changePercent = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(row.f170 ?? row.f3)
      : numberOrNull(row.change_percent)
    const name = textOrEmpty(provider === 'eastmoney' ? row.f58 ?? row.f14 : row.name)
    const base: JsonRecord = {
      symbol: symbol.canonical,
      name,
      price,
      previous_close: previousClose,
      change: change ?? calculateChange(price, previousClose),
      change_percent: changePercent ?? calculateChangePercent(price, previousClose),
      market_time: quoteTime(provider, row),
    }
    if (detail === 'full') {
      const rawVolume = provider === 'eastmoney'
        ? numberOrNull(row.f47 ?? row.f5)
        : provider === 'tencent'
          ? numberOrNull(row.volume_lots)
          : numberOrNull(row.volume_shares)
      const rawAmount = provider === 'eastmoney'
        ? numberOrNull(row.f48 ?? row.f6)
        : provider === 'tencent'
          ? multiplyOrNull(numberOrNull(row.amount_ten_thousand_cny), 10_000)
          : numberOrNull(row.amount_cny)
      Object.assign(base, {
        open: provider === 'eastmoney' ? numberOrNull(row.f46 ?? row.f17) : numberOrNull(row.open),
        high: provider === 'eastmoney' ? numberOrNull(row.f44 ?? row.f15) : numberOrNull(row.high),
        low: provider === 'eastmoney' ? numberOrNull(row.f45 ?? row.f16) : numberOrNull(row.low),
        volume_shares: normalizeShareVolume(provider, symbol, rawVolume),
        amount: rawAmount,
        amount_currency: 'CNY',
        turnover_rate: provider === 'eastmoney' ? numberOrNull(row.f168 ?? row.f8) : numberOrNull(row.turnover_rate),
      })
    }
    quotes.push(base)
    returned.add(symbol.canonical)
  }
  return {
    detail,
    quotes,
    unavailable_symbols: requested.filter(symbol => !returned.has(symbol.canonical)).map(symbol => symbol.canonical),
  }
}

function normalizeKline(
  provider: StockDataProvider,
  value: StockApiJson,
  symbol: CanonicalSymbol,
  period: string,
  adjust: string,
  limit: number,
): StockApiJson {
  const rows = klineRows(provider, value, period, adjust)
  const byTime = new Map<string, JsonRecord>()
  for (const row of rows) {
    const parsed = parseKlineRow(provider, row, symbol)
    if (parsed !== undefined) byTime.set(parsed.time as string, parsed)
  }
  const bars = [...byTime.values()].slice(-limit)
  if (bars.length === 0) throw invalidUpstream('K 线')
  return { symbol: symbol.canonical, period, adjust, bars }
}

function klineRows(provider: StockDataProvider, value: StockApiJson, period: string, adjust: string): readonly StockApiJson[] {
  if (provider === 'eastmoney') {
    const rows = asRecord(asRecord(value)?.data)?.klines
    return Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []
  }
  if (provider === 'sina') return Array.isArray(value) ? value : []
  if (provider === 'tencent') {
    const root = asRecord(value)
    const data = asRecord(root?.data)
    if (data === undefined) return []
    const security = Object.values(data).find(item => asRecord(item) !== undefined)
    const record = asRecord(security)
    if (record === undefined) return []
    const prefix = adjust === 'none' || period.endsWith('m') ? '' : adjust
    const preferredKey = period.endsWith('m') ? `m${period.slice(0, -1)}` : `${prefix}${period}`
    const preferred = record[preferredKey] ?? record[period] ?? record[`${adjust}${period}`]
    if (Array.isArray(preferred)) return preferred
    return Object.values(record).find(item => Array.isArray(item) && item.every(row => Array.isArray(row))) as StockApiJson[] | undefined ?? []
  }
  const dataString = findDataString(value)
  return dataString === undefined ? [] : dataString.split(';').filter(Boolean)
}

function parseKlineRow(provider: StockDataProvider, value: StockApiJson, symbol: CanonicalSymbol): JsonRecord | undefined {
  if (provider === 'sina') {
    const row = asRecord(value)
    if (row === undefined) return undefined
    return validBar(
      textOrEmpty(row.day ?? row.date),
      row.open,
      row.high,
      row.low,
      row.close,
      normalizeShareVolume(provider, symbol, numberOrNull(row.volume)),
      numberOrNull(row.amount),
    )
  }
  const fields = Array.isArray(value)
    ? value
    : typeof value === 'string'
      ? value.split(',')
      : []
  if (fields.length < 6) return undefined
  if (provider === 'tonghuashun') {
    return validBar(
      textOrEmpty(fields[0]), fields[1], fields[2], fields[3], fields[4],
      normalizeShareVolume(provider, symbol, numberOrNull(fields[5])), numberOrNull(fields[6]),
    )
  }
  return validBar(
    textOrEmpty(fields[0]), fields[1], fields[3], fields[4], fields[2],
    normalizeShareVolume(provider, symbol, numberOrNull(fields[5])), numberOrNull(fields[6]),
  )
}

function validBar(
  time: string,
  openValue: StockApiJson | undefined,
  highValue: StockApiJson | undefined,
  lowValue: StockApiJson | undefined,
  closeValue: StockApiJson | undefined,
  volumeShares: number | null,
  amount: number | null,
): JsonRecord | undefined {
  const open = numberOrNull(openValue)
  const high = numberOrNull(highValue)
  const low = numberOrNull(lowValue)
  const close = numberOrNull(closeValue)
  if (time.length === 0 || open === null || high === null || low === null || close === null) return undefined
  return { time, open, high, low, close, volume_shares: volumeShares, amount }
}

function normalizeIntraday(
  provider: StockDataProvider,
  value: StockApiJson,
  symbol: CanonicalSymbol,
  days: number,
  limit: number,
): StockApiJson {
  let rows: readonly StockApiJson[] = []
  let previousClose: number | null = null
  if (provider === 'eastmoney') {
    const data = asRecord(asRecord(value)?.data)
    rows = Array.isArray(data?.trends) ? data.trends : []
    previousClose = numberOrNull(data?.preClose)
  } else if (provider === 'tencent') {
    const data = asRecord(asRecord(value)?.data)
    const security = data === undefined ? undefined : Object.values(data).find(item => asRecord(item) !== undefined)
    const nested = asRecord(asRecord(security)?.data)
    rows = Array.isArray(nested?.data) ? nested.data : []
  } else {
    const dataString = findDataString(value)
    rows = dataString === undefined ? [] : dataString.split(';').filter(Boolean)
  }

  const points: StockApiJson[] = []
  for (const item of rows) {
    const fields = typeof item === 'string'
      ? item.trim().split(provider === 'tencent' ? /\s+/u : ',')
      : Array.isArray(item) ? item : []
    if (fields.length < 2) continue
    const time = textOrEmpty(fields[0])
    const price = numberOrNull(fields[provider === 'eastmoney' ? 2 : 1])
    if (time.length === 0 || price === null) continue
    const averagePrice = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(fields[7])
      : provider === 'tonghuashun'
        ? numberOrNull(fields[3])
        : null
    const volume = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(fields[5])
      : provider === 'tencent'
        ? numberOrNull(fields[2])
        : numberOrNull(fields[4])
    const amount = provider === 'eastmoney'
      ? numberOrNull(fields[6])
      : provider === 'tencent'
        ? numberOrNull(fields[3])
        : numberOrNull(fields[2])
    points.push({
      time,
      price,
      average_price: averagePrice,
      cumulative_volume_shares: normalizeShareVolume(provider, symbol, volume),
      cumulative_amount: amount,
    })
  }
  if (points.length === 0) throw invalidUpstream('分时走势')
  const sampled = points.length > limit
  return {
    symbol: symbol.canonical,
    days,
    previous_close: previousClose,
    sampled,
    points: sampled ? sampleStockApiItems(points, limit) : points,
  }
}

function normalizeRanking(
  value: StockApiJson,
  page: number,
  limit: number,
  order: 'asc' | 'desc',
  sort: string,
  sectors: boolean,
  paginateLocally = false,
): StockApiJson {
  const sourceRows = findRecordRows(value) ?? keyedRows(value)
  if (sourceRows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream(sectors ? '板块排行' : '个股排行')
  const items = sourceRows.map(row => rankingItem(row, sectors)).filter((item): item is JsonRecord => item !== undefined)
  const ordered = paginateLocally && items.some(item => numberOrNull(item[sort]) !== null)
    ? [...items].sort((left, right) => compareNullableNumbers(numberOrNull(left[sort]), numberOrNull(right[sort]), order))
    : items
  const offset = paginateLocally ? (page - 1) * limit : 0
  return { page, limit, items: ordered.slice(offset, offset + limit) }
}

function rankingItem(row: JsonRecord, sectors: boolean): JsonRecord | undefined {
  const code = firstText(row.f12, row.code, row.symbol, row.sector_code, row.node, row.id)
  const name = firstText(row.f14, row.name, row.sector_name, row.cname, row.label)
  if (code.length === 0 && name.length === 0) return undefined
  let item: JsonRecord
  if (sectors) {
    item = { id: code, name }
  } else {
    const symbol = inferCanonicalSymbol(code)
    if (symbol === null) return undefined
    item = { code, symbol, name }
  }
  Object.assign(item, {
    price: firstNumber(row.f2, row.price, row.trade, row.now),
    change: firstNumber(row.f4, row.change, row.pricechange, row.zd),
    change_percent: firstNumber(row.f3, row.change_percent, row.changepercent, row.zdf, row.percent),
    volume: firstNumber(row.f5, row.volume),
    amount: firstNumber(row.f6, row.amount),
    turnover_rate: firstNumber(row.f8, row.turnover_rate, row.turnoverratio, row.hsl),
    net_inflow: firstNumber(row.f62, row.net_inflow, row.netamount),
  })
  return item
}

function normalizeSectorCatalog(value: StockApiJson, sectorType: string): StockApiJson {
  const rows = keyedRows(value) ?? findRecordRows(value)
  if (rows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('板块目录')
  const items: StockApiJson[] = []
  for (const row of rows) {
    const id = firstText(row.id, row.code, row.node)
    const name = firstText(row.name, row.label, row.cname)
    if (id.length > 0 || name.length > 0) items.push({ id, name })
  }
  return { sector_type: sectorType, items }
}

function normalizeMoneyFlow(
  value: StockApiJson,
  symbol: CanonicalSymbol,
  page: number,
  limit: number,
): StockApiJson {
  const root = asRecord(value)
  const klines = asRecord(root?.data)?.klines
  if (Array.isArray(klines)) {
    const items = klines.map(item => moneyFlowLine(item)).filter((item): item is JsonRecord => item !== undefined)
    const offset = (page - 1) * limit
    return { symbol: symbol.canonical, page, limit, items: items.slice(offset, offset + limit) }
  }
  const rows = findRecordRows(value)
  if (rows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('资金流')
  return {
    symbol: symbol.canonical,
    page,
    limit,
    items: rows.slice(0, limit).map(row => ({
      time: firstText(row.date, row.day, row.opendate, row.ticktime),
      main_net_inflow: firstNumber(row.main_net_inflow, row.netamount, row.r0_net),
      large_net_inflow: firstNumber(row.large_net_inflow, row.r1_net),
      medium_net_inflow: firstNumber(row.medium_net_inflow, row.r2_net),
      small_net_inflow: firstNumber(row.small_net_inflow, row.r3_net),
      close: firstNumber(row.close, row.trade),
      change_percent: firstNumber(row.change_percent, row.changeratio),
    })),
  }
}

function moneyFlowLine(value: StockApiJson): JsonRecord | undefined {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return undefined
  const fields = value.split(',')
  const time = fields[0]?.trim() ?? ''
  if (time.length === 0) return undefined
  return {
    time,
    main_net_inflow: numberOrNull(fields[1]),
    small_net_inflow: numberOrNull(fields[2]),
    medium_net_inflow: numberOrNull(fields[3]),
    large_net_inflow: numberOrNull(fields[4]),
    super_large_net_inflow: numberOrNull(fields[5]),
    main_net_ratio: numberOrNull(fields[6]),
    small_net_ratio: numberOrNull(fields[7]),
    medium_net_ratio: numberOrNull(fields[8]),
    large_net_ratio: numberOrNull(fields[9]),
    super_large_net_ratio: numberOrNull(fields[10]),
    close: numberOrNull(fields[11]),
    change_percent: numberOrNull(fields[12]),
  }
}

function normalizeConnectFlow(value: StockApiJson, direction: string, limit: number): StockApiJson {
  const data = asRecord(asRecord(value)?.data)
  if (data === undefined || !Array.isArray(data.s2n) || !Array.isArray(data.n2s)) throw invalidUpstream('沪深港通资金流')

  const northboundRows = connectFlowRows(data.s2n, data.s2nDate)
  const southboundRows = connectFlowRows(data.n2s, data.n2sDate)
  const northboundAvailable = hasReportedConnectFlow(northboundRows)
  const southboundAvailable = hasReportedConnectFlow(southboundRows)
  const requestedNorthbound = direction === 'all' || direction === 'northbound'
  const requestedSouthbound = direction === 'all' || direction === 'southbound'
  const hasRequestedData = (requestedNorthbound && northboundAvailable)
    || (requestedSouthbound && southboundAvailable)
  if (!hasRequestedData) throw invalidUpstream('沪深港通资金流')

  const unavailableDirections: StockApiJson[] = []
  if (requestedNorthbound && !northboundAvailable) unavailableDirections.push('northbound')
  if (requestedSouthbound && !southboundAvailable) unavailableDirections.push('southbound')
  return {
    direction,
    amount_currency: 'CNY',
    unavailable_directions: unavailableDirections,
    ...(requestedNorthbound
      ? { northbound: northboundAvailable ? northboundRows.slice(-limit) : [] }
      : {}),
    ...(requestedSouthbound
      ? { southbound: southboundAvailable ? southboundRows.slice(-limit) : [] }
      : {}),
  }
}

function connectFlowRows(rows: readonly StockApiJson[], date: StockApiJson | undefined): JsonRecord[] {
  const parsed: JsonRecord[] = []
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (typeof row !== 'string') continue
    const fields = row.split(',')
    const time = fields[0]?.trim() ?? ''
    if (!/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/u.test(time)) continue
    const shanghaiLeg = numberOrNull(fields[1])
    const shenzhenLeg = numberOrNull(fields[3])
    const total = numberOrNull(fields[5])
    if (shanghaiLeg === null && shenzhenLeg === null && total === null) continue
    parsed.push({
      date: nonEmptyOrNull(date),
      time,
      shanghai_leg_net_inflow: tenThousandCnyToYuan(shanghaiLeg),
      shenzhen_leg_net_inflow: tenThousandCnyToYuan(shenzhenLeg),
      total_net_inflow: tenThousandCnyToYuan(total),
    })
  }
  return parsed
}

function tenThousandCnyToYuan(value: number | null): number | null {
  return value === null ? null : Math.round(value * 10_000)
}

function hasReportedConnectFlow(rows: readonly JsonRecord[]): boolean {
  return rows.some(row => [
    row.shanghai_leg_net_inflow,
    row.shenzhen_leg_net_inflow,
    row.total_net_inflow,
  ].some(value => {
    const amount = numberOrNull(value)
    return amount !== null && amount !== 0
  }))
}

function connectUnavailableDirections(value: StockApiJson): string[] {
  const directions = asRecord(value)?.unavailable_directions
  return Array.isArray(directions)
    ? directions.filter((direction): direction is string => typeof direction === 'string')
    : []
}

function connectDirectionLabel(direction: string): string {
  return direction === 'northbound' ? '北向' : direction === 'southbound' ? '南向' : direction
}

function normalizeSectorMoneyFlow(
  value: StockApiJson,
  sectorType: string,
  page: number,
  limit: number,
): StockApiJson {
  const rows = findRecordRows(value)
  if (rows === undefined || (page === 1 && rows.length === 0)) throw invalidUpstream('板块资金流')
  const items = rows.map(row => rankingItem(row, true)).filter((item): item is JsonRecord => item !== undefined)
  if (items.length === 0) throw invalidUpstream('板块资金流')
  return { sector_type: sectorType, page, limit, items: items.slice(0, limit) }
}

function normalizeGenericItems(value: StockApiJson, page: number, limit: number): StockApiJson {
  const rows = findRecordRows(value)
  if (rows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('列表')
  return { page, limit, items: rows.slice(0, limit) }
}

function normalizeFeed(value: StockApiJson, page: number, limit: number): StockApiJson {
  const root = asRecord(value)
  const direct = root?.items
  const dataList = asRecord(root?.data)?.list
  const rows = Array.isArray(direct)
    ? direct
    : Array.isArray(dataList)
      ? dataList
      : findRecordRows(value)
  if (rows === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('资讯列表')
  return { page, limit, items: rows.slice(0, limit) }
}

function normalizeSearch(value: StockApiJson, scope: string, page: number, limit: number): StockApiJson {
  const root = asRecord(value)
  const payload = asRecord(root?.data) ?? root
  const result = asRecord(payload?.result)
  const key = scope === 'news' ? 'cmsArticleWebOld' : scope === 'guba' ? 'gubaArticleWeb' : 'labelList'
  const rows = result?.[key]
  if (Array.isArray(rows)) return { scope, page, limit, items: rows.slice(0, limit) }
  const nestedData = asRecord(root?.data)
  const nestedResult = asRecord(nestedData?.result)
  if (Array.isArray(nestedResult?.[key])) {
    return { scope, page, limit, items: nestedResult[key].slice(0, limit) }
  }
  const generic = findRecordRows(value)
  if (generic === undefined) throw invalidUpstream('搜索')
  return { scope, page, limit, items: generic.slice(0, limit) }
}

function normalizeHtmlPage(value: StockApiJson, label: string): StockApiJson {
  const body = asRecord(value)?.body
  if (typeof body !== 'string') throw invalidUpstream(label)
  const text = decodeHtmlEntities(body
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/giu, ' ')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/giu, ' ')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/gu, ' '))
    .replace(/\s+/gu, ' ')
    .trim()
  if (text.length === 0) throw invalidUpstream(label)
  const maxCharacters = 12_000
  return {
    content_type: 'text/plain',
    text: text.slice(0, maxCharacters),
    truncated: text.length > maxCharacters,
  }
}

function findRecordRows(value: StockApiJson, depth = 0): JsonRecord[] | undefined {
  if (depth > 6) return undefined
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length === 0) return []
    const records = value.map(asRecord).filter((item): item is JsonRecord => item !== undefined)
    if (records.length === value.length) return records
    for (const item of value) {
      const nested = findRecordRows(item, depth + 1)
      if (nested !== undefined) return nested
    }
    return undefined
  }
  const record = asRecord(value)
  if (record === undefined) return undefined
  for (const nested of Object.values(record)) {
    const rows = findRecordRows(nested, depth + 1)
    if (rows !== undefined) return rows
  }
  return undefined
}

function keyedRows(value: StockApiJson): JsonRecord[] | undefined {
  const record = asRecord(value)
  if (record === undefined) return undefined
  const entries = Object.entries(record).filter(([, item]) => (
    typeof item === 'string' || typeof item === 'number' || asRecord(item) !== undefined
  ))
  if (entries.length === 0) return undefined
  return entries.map(([id, item]): JsonRecord => {
    const nested = asRecord(item)
    if (nested !== undefined) return Object.assign({ id }, nested)
    const fields = String(item).split(',')
    return {
      id,
      name: fields[0]?.trim() ?? id,
      price: numberOrNull(fields[1]),
      change_percent: fields.map(numberOrNull).find(number => number !== null) ?? null,
    }
  })
}

function findDataString(value: StockApiJson): string | undefined {
  const record = asRecord(value)
  if (typeof record?.data === 'string') return record.data
  if (typeof record?.raw === 'string') {
    const match = /["']data["']\s*:\s*["']([^"']*)["']/u.exec(record.raw)
    return match?.[1]
  }
  return undefined
}

function requireRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) throw badRequest('工具参数必须是对象。')
  return value as Record<string, unknown>
}

function asRecord(value: StockApiJson | undefined): JsonRecord | undefined {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : undefined
}

function assertAllowed(args: Record<string, unknown>, action: string, allowed: readonly string[]): void {
  const allowedSet = new Set(['action', ...allowed])
  const extra = Object.keys(args).filter(key => !allowedSet.has(key))
  if (extra.length > 0) throw badRequest(`${action} 不接受参数：${extra.join('、')}。`)
}

function rejectPresent(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, label: string): void {
  if (Object.hasOwn(args, key)) throw badRequest(`${label} 不接受参数：${key}。`)
}

function requiredEnum<const T extends readonly (string | number)[]>(
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
  key: string,
  values: T,
): T[number] {
  const value = args[key]
  if (!values.includes(value as never)) throw badRequest(`${key} 必须为：${values.join('、')}。`)
  return value as T[number]
}

function optionalEnum<const T extends readonly (string | number)[]>(
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
  key: string,
  values: T,
  fallback: T[number],
): T[number] {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(args, key)) return fallback
  return requiredEnum(args, key, values)
}

function requiredString(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, pattern?: RegExp): string {
  const value = args[key]
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim().length === 0 || (pattern !== undefined && !pattern.test(value))) {
    throw badRequest(`${key} 格式无效。`)
  }
  return value
}

function optionalString(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, pattern?: RegExp): string | undefined {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(args, key)) return undefined
  return requiredString(args, key, pattern)
}

function optionalInteger(
  args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, fallback: number, minimum: number, maximum: number,
): number {
  return optionalIntegerValue(args, key, minimum, maximum) ?? fallback
}

function optionalIntegerValue(
  args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, minimum: number, maximum: number,
): number | undefined {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(args, key)) return undefined
  const value = args[key]
  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || (value as number) < minimum || (value as number) > maximum) {
    throw badRequest(`${key} 必须是 ${minimum} 到 ${maximum} 之间的整数。`)
  }
  return value as number
}

function optionalBoolean(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, fallback: boolean): boolean {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(args, key)) return fallback
  if (typeof args[key] !== 'boolean') throw badRequest(`${key} 必须是布尔值。`)
  return args[key]
}

function optionalDate(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): string | undefined {
  const value = optionalString(args, key, /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/u)
  if (value === undefined) return undefined
  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) throw badRequest(`${key} 不是有效日期。`)
  return value
}

function symbolArg(args: Record<string, unknown>, key = 'symbol'): CanonicalSymbol {
  return parseCanonicalSymbol(requiredString(args, key))
}

function symbolArray(args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, maximum: number): CanonicalSymbol[] {
  const value = args[key]
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0 || value.length > maximum) {
    throw badRequest(`${key} 必须是包含 1 到 ${maximum} 个证券代码的数组。`)
  }
  const symbols = value.map((item, index) => {
    if (typeof item !== 'string') throw badRequest(`${key}[${index}] 必须是证券代码。`)
    return parseCanonicalSymbol(item)
  })
  if (new Set(symbols.map(symbol => symbol.canonical)).size !== symbols.length) throw badRequest(`${key} 不允许重复证券代码。`)
  return symbols
}

function optionalStringArray<const T extends readonly string[]>(
  args: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, values: T, fallback: readonly T[number][],
): T[number][] {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(args, key)) return [...fallback]
  const value = args[key]
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0 || value.length > values.length) throw badRequest(`${key} 数组长度无效。`)
  const selected = value.map(item => {
    if (typeof item !== 'string' || !values.includes(item as T[number])) throw badRequest(`${key} 包含无效值。`)
    return item as T[number]
  })
  if (new Set(selected).size !== selected.length) throw badRequest(`${key} 不允许重复值。`)
  return selected
}

function parseCanonicalSymbol(value: string): CanonicalSymbol {
  const normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase()
  const match = /^(\d{6})\.(SH|SZ)$/u.exec(normalized)

  const value = row.f107 ?? row.f13
  if (value === undefined || value === null || textOrEmpty(value).length === 0) return undefined

  if (value === 0 || value === '0') return 'SZ'

  if (provider === 'tencent') return nonEmptyOrNull(row.market_time)
  if (provider === 'sina') {

    return `${date} ${time}`.trim() || null

  return nonEmptyOrNull(row.f292)
}

  if (value === null) return null
  if (provider === 'eastmoney' || provider === 'tencent') return value * 100
  return value
}

function calculateChange(price: number | null, previousClose: number | null): number | null {
  return price === null || previousClose === null ? null : price - previousClose
}

function calculateChangePercent(price: number | null, previousClose: number | null): number | null {
  return price === null || previousClose === null || previousClose === 0 ? null : ((price - previousClose) / previousClose) * 100
}

function multiplyOrNull(value: number | null, multiplier: number): number | null {
  return value === null ? null : value * multiplier
}

function numberOrNull(value: StockApiJson | undefined): number | null {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim() === '') return null
  const number = Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null
}

function firstNumber(...values: readonly (StockApiJson | undefined)[]): number | null {
  for (const value of values) {
    const number = numberOrNull(value)
    if (number !== null) return number

  return null
}

function textOrEmpty(value: StockApiJson | undefined): string {
  return typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' ? String(value).trim() : ''
}

function firstText(...values: readonly (StockApiJson | undefined)[]): string {
  for (const value of values) {
    const text = textOrEmpty(value)
    if (text.length > 0) return text
  }
  return ''
}

function nonEmptyOrNull(value: StockApiJson | undefined): StockApiJson {
  const text = textOrEmpty(value)
  return text.length === 0 ? null : text
}

function inferCanonicalSymbol(code: string): string | null {
  const source = code.toLowerCase()
  const normalized = source.replace(/^(?:sh|sz)/u, '')
  if (!/^\d{6}$/u.test(normalized)) return null
  const market = /^(?:600|601|603|605|688)/u.test(normalized)
    ? 'SH'
    : /^(?:000|001|002|003|300|301)/u.test(normalized)
      ? 'SZ'
      : undefined
  if (market === undefined) return null
  if ((source.startsWith('sh') || source.startsWith('sz')) && source.slice(0, 2) !== market.toLowerCase()) return null
  return `${normalized}.${market}`
}

function sampleStockApiItems(items: readonly StockApiJson[], limit: number): StockApiJson[] {
  if (items.length <= limit) return [...items]
  if (limit === 1) return [items[items.length - 1]]
  const lastIndex = items.length - 1
  return Array.from({ length: limit }, (_, index) => items[Math.round((index * lastIndex) / (limit - 1))])
}

function compareNullableNumbers(left: number | null, right: number | null, order: 'asc' | 'desc'): number {
  if (left === null && right === null) return 0
  if (left === null) return 1
  if (right === null) return -1
  return order === 'asc' ? left - right : right - left
}

function decodeHtmlEntities(value: string): string {
  return value

    .replace(/&/giu, '&')
    .replace(/</giu, '<')
    .replace(/>/giu, '>')
    .replace(/"/giu, '"')
    .replace(/'/giu, "'")

function requireCapability(tool: string) {
  const capability = findStockCapability(tool)
  if (capability === undefined) throw badRequest(`未知股票工具：${tool}。`)

function requireCapabilityAction(capability: ReturnType<typeof requireCapability>, action: string) {
  const definition = capability.actions.find(candidate => candidate.name === action)
  if (definition === undefined) throw badRequest(`${capability.name} 不存在 action=${action}。`)

function fallbackNote(fallback: 'equivalent' | 'methodology' | 'none'): string {

function isFallbackError(error: unknown): error is StockApiError {

function invalidUpstream(label: string): StockApiError {
  return new StockApiError(`${label}返回了无法解析的数据。`, 'upstream')
}

function badRequest(message: string): StockApiError {
  return new StockApiError(message, 'bad-request')
}

import type { ToolExecution } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
import { STOCK_AGENT_TOOL_NAMES } from './stock-agent-contract.ts'

export const STOCK_TOOL_NAMES = STOCK_AGENT_TOOL_NAMES

export const STOCK_TOOL_ACCESS_EVENT = 'stock-market/tool-access'

const STOCK_TOOL_NAME_SET = new Set<string>(STOCK_TOOL_NAMES)
const DISABLED_REASON = '当前会话已关闭股票工具调用，请先在输入框中开启。'

type StockAgent = NonNullable<ToolExecution['agent']>
type StockSessionEvent = {
  readonly type: string
  readonly data?: unknown
}

interface AgentRegistryView {
  get(id: string): StockAgent | undefined
  list(): readonly StockAgent[]
}

type ContextWithAgents = Omit<Context, 'agents'> & {
  agents: AgentRegistryView
}

/** Last logged stock-tool choice wins; sessions without any event fall back to the configured default. */
export function foldStockToolAccess(events: readonly StockSessionEvent[], defaultEnabled = true): boolean {
  for (let index = events.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
    const event = events[index]
    if (event.type !== STOCK_TOOL_ACCESS_EVENT || !isRecord(event.data)) continue
    if (typeof event.data.enabled === 'boolean') return event.data.enabled
  }
  return defaultEnabled
}

/** Owns durable per-session state, model-visible tool filtering, and final execution denial. */
export class StockToolAccessService {
  private readonly restrictions = new Map<StockAgent, () => void>()

  constructor(
    private readonly ctx: ContextWithAgents,
    private readonly defaultEnabled = true,
  ) {
    ctx.effect(() => () => { this.disposeRestrictions() }, 'dsh-stock-market: tool restrictions')
    for (const agent of ctx.agents.list()) this.syncRestriction(agent)

    ctx.on('agent/created', ({ agent }) => { this.syncRestriction(agent) })
    ctx.on('agent/disposed', ({ agent }) => { this.liftRestriction(agent) })
    ctx.on('tools/pre-execute', async (exec, next) => {
      const reason = this.guardReason(exec)
      return reason === undefined ? next() : { kind: 'deny', reason }
    })
    ctx.tools.guard(exec => this.guardReason(exec))
  }

  getBySessionId(sessionId: string): boolean {
    const agent = this.requireAgent(sessionId)
    this.syncRestriction(agent)
    return foldStockToolAccess(agent.session.events, this.defaultEnabled)
  }

  setBySessionId(sessionId: string, enabled: boolean): boolean {
    const agent = this.requireAgent(sessionId)
    const current = foldStockToolAccess(agent.session.events, this.defaultEnabled)
    if (current === enabled) {
      this.syncRestriction(agent)
      return current
    }

    if (!enabled) {
      const installed = this.installRestriction(agent)
      try {
        appendAccessEvent(agent, false)
      } catch (error) {
        if (installed) this.liftRestriction(agent)
        throw error
      }
      return false
    }

    appendAccessEvent(agent, true)
    this.liftRestriction(agent)
    return true
  }

  private requireAgent(sessionId: string): StockAgent {
    const agent = this.ctx.agents.get(sessionId)
    if (agent === undefined || agent.session.id !== sessionId) {
      throw new Error(`会话不存在或当前不可用：${sessionId}。`)
    }
    return agent
  }

  private syncRestriction(agent: StockAgent): void {
    if (foldStockToolAccess(agent.session.events, this.defaultEnabled)) this.liftRestriction(agent)
    else this.installRestriction(agent)
  }

  private installRestriction(agent: StockAgent): boolean {
    if (this.restrictions.has(agent)) return false
    const dispose = agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny: STOCK_TOOL_NAMES })
    this.restrictions.set(agent, dispose)
    return true
  }

  private liftRestriction(agent: StockAgent): void {
    const dispose = this.restrictions.get(agent)
    if (dispose === undefined) return
    this.restrictions.delete(agent)
    dispose()
  }

  private disposeRestrictions(): void {
    const errors: unknown[] = []
    for (const [agent, dispose] of [...this.restrictions]) {
      this.restrictions.delete(agent)
      try {
        dispose()
      } catch (error) {
        errors.push(error)
      }
    }
    if (errors.length > 0) throw new AggregateError(errors, '股票工具限制清理失败。')
  }

  private guardReason(exec: Readonly<ToolExecution>): string | undefined {
    if (!STOCK_TOOL_NAME_SET.has(exec.name) || exec.agent === undefined) return undefined
    return foldStockToolAccess(exec.agent.session.events, this.defaultEnabled) ? undefined : DISABLED_REASON
  }
}

function appendAccessEvent(agent: StockAgent, enabled: boolean): void {
  const session = agent.session as unknown as {
    append(type: string, data: { enabled: boolean }): unknown
  }
  session.append(STOCK_TOOL_ACCESS_EVENT, { enabled })
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

        : fallbackUrls[Math.min(attempt - 1, fallbackUrls.length - 1)]
      try {
        const response = await fetcher(requestUrl, {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: request.headers,
          redirect: 'error',
          signal,
        })
        if (response.ok) {
          return await readBoundedText(response, request.encoding, request.maxResponseBytes ?? MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES)
        }
        try {
          await response.body?.cancel()
        } catch {
          // The HTTP status remains authoritative if cancellation fails.
        }
        if (attempt < 2 && RETRYABLE_STATUSES.has(response.status)) {
          await this.sleep(1_000 * (2 ** attempt), signal)
          continue
        }
        throw new StockApiError(`${label}请求失败：HTTP ${response.status}。`)
      } catch (error) {
        if (signal.aborted) throw new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled')
        if (error instanceof StockApiError) throw error
        if (attempt < 2) {
          await this.sleep(1_000 * (2 ** attempt), signal)
          continue
        }
        throw new StockApiError(`${label}网络请求失败。`)
      }
    }
    throw new StockApiError(`${label}请求失败。`)
  }
}

function eastmoneyRequest(
  requestUrl: string,
  responseKind: ResponseKind = 'json',
  referer = 'https://data.eastmoney.com/',
): PublicRequest {
  const fallbackUrls = eastmoneyFallbackUrls(requestUrl)
  return {
    url: requestUrl,
    ...(fallbackUrls.length === 0 ? {} : { fallbackUrls }),
    encoding: 'utf-8',
    responseKind,
    headers: {
      Accept: responseKind === 'html' ? 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml' : 'application/json, text/plain, */*',
      Referer: referer,
      'User-Agent': USER_AGENT,
    },
  }
}

function eastmoneyFallbackUrls(requestUrl: string): readonly string[] {
  const target = new URL(requestUrl)
  if (!['push2.eastmoney.com', 'push2his.eastmoney.com'].includes(target.hostname)) return []
  return [`https://push2delay.eastmoney.com${target.pathname}${target.search}`]
}

function tencentRequest(
  requestUrl: string,
  encoding: TextEncoding = 'utf-8',
  responseKind: ResponseKind = 'json',
): PublicRequest {
  return {
    url: requestUrl,
    encoding,
    responseKind,
    headers: {
      Accept: responseKind === 'tencent-quotes' ? 'text/plain, */*' : 'application/json, text/plain, */*',
      'User-Agent': USER_AGENT,
    },
  }
}

function sinaRequest(
  requestUrl: string,

  responseKind: ResponseKind = 'json',
): PublicRequest {
  return {
    url: requestUrl,
    encoding,
    responseKind,
    headers: {

function tonghuashunRequest(requestUrl: string): PublicRequest {
