function restrictResponseToPluginScope(
  endpoint: DocumentedPublicEndpoint,
  parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>,
  value: StockApiJson,
): StockApiJson {
  if (endpoint.id !== 'em_global_search' || parameters.scope !== 'stock') return value
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isRecord(value.result) || !Array.isArray(value.result.labelList)) return value

  const labelList = value.result.labelList.map(label => {
    if (!isRecord(label)) return label
    const { count: upstreamCount, ...rest } = label
    const quoteList = Array.isArray(label.quoteList)
      ? label.quoteList.filter(isEastMoneyAShareSearchQuote)
      : []
    return {
      ...rest,
      name: '沪深 A 股',
      type: 'A_STOCK',
      returned_count: quoteList.length,
      ...(typeof upstreamCount === 'number' || typeof upstreamCount === 'string'
        ? { upstream_count: upstreamCount }
        : {}),
      quoteList,
    }
  })
  return toJsonValue({
    ...value,
    result: { ...value.result, labelList },
  }, '东方财富股票搜索响应')
}

function isEastMoneyAShareSearchQuote(value: unknown): boolean {
  if (!isRecord(value) || typeof value.code !== 'string') return false
  if (/^(?:600|601|603|605|688)\d{3}$/u.test(value.code)) {
    return value.market === 1 || value.market === '1'
  }
  if (/^(?:000|001|002|003|300|301)\d{3}$/u.test(value.code)) {
    return value.market === 0 || value.market === '0'
  }
  return false
}

function validateBusinessResponse(
  endpoint: DocumentedPublicEndpoint,
  parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>,
  value: StockApiJson,
): void {
  if (endpoint.provider === 'eastmoney') {
    validateEastMoneyBusinessResponse(endpoint, parameters, value)
    return
  }

  if (endpoint.provider === 'tencent' && endpoint.id !== 'tx_realtime_quotes') {
    if (!isRecord(value)) throw new StockApiError('腾讯财经返回了无效数据。')
    const message = businessMessage(value)
    if (value.code !== 0 && value.code !== '0') {
      throw new StockApiError(`腾讯财经业务请求失败${message}。`)
    }
  }
}

function validateEastMoneyBusinessResponse(
  endpoint: DocumentedPublicEndpoint,
  parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>,
  value: StockApiJson,
): void {
  if (endpoint.id === 'em_guba_page') return
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new StockApiError('东方财富返回了无效数据。')

  if (endpoint.id === 'em_datacenter_report') {
    if (value.success !== true || (value.code !== 0 && value.code !== '0')) {
      throw new StockApiError(`东方财富数据中心业务请求失败${businessMessage(value)}。`)
    }
    requireNestedArray(value, 'result', 'data', '东方财富数据中心')
    return
  }

  if (endpoint.id === 'em_global_search') {
    if (value.code !== 0 && value.code !== '0') {
      throw new StockApiError(`东方财富搜索业务请求失败${businessMessage(value)}。`)
    }
    const result = value.result
    if (!isRecord(result)) throw new StockApiError('东方财富搜索响应缺少 result。')
    const scope = stringParameter(parameters, 'scope')
    const resultKey = scope === 'stock' || scope === 'fund'
      ? 'labelList'
      : requiredMapping(EASTMONEY_CONTENT_SEARCH_TYPES, scope, endpoint.id)
    if (!Array.isArray(result[resultKey])) {
      throw new StockApiError(`东方财富搜索响应缺少 ${resultKey} 列表。`)
    }
    return
  }

  if (endpoint.id === 'em_channel_news') {
    requireNestedArray(value, 'data', 'list', '东方财富频道资讯')
    return
  }

  requireEastMoneySuccess(value)
  switch (endpoint.id) {
    case 'em_realtime_quote':
      if (!isRecord(value.data)) throw new StockApiError('东方财富实时行情响应缺少 data。')
      return
    case 'em_market_snapshot':
    case 'em_batch_quotes':
      requireNestedArray(value, 'data', 'diff', '东方财富行情')
      return
    case 'em_price_history':
    case 'em_money_flow_history':
    case 'em_money_flow_intraday':
      requireNestedArray(value, 'data', 'klines', '东方财富历史行情')
      return
    case 'em_intraday_trends':
      requireNestedArray(value, 'data', 'trends', '东方财富分时行情')
      return
    case 'em_connect_flow': {
      const data = value.data
      if (!isRecord(data) || !Array.isArray(data.s2n) || !Array.isArray(data.n2s)) {
        throw new StockApiError('东方财富沪深港通响应缺少 data.s2n 或 data.n2s 列表。')
      }
      return
    }
  }
}

function requireEastMoneySuccess(value: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  if (value.rc === 0 || value.rc === '0') return
  throw new StockApiError(`东方财富业务请求失败${businessMessage(value)}。`)
}

function requireNestedArray(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
  recordKey: string,
  arrayKey: string,
  label: string,
): void {
  const nested = value[recordKey]
  if (!isRecord(nested) || !Array.isArray(nested[arrayKey])) {
    throw new StockApiError(`${label}响应缺少 ${recordKey}.${arrayKey} 列表。`)
  }
}

function businessMessage(value: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const detail = [value.message, value.msg].find(item => typeof item === 'string' && item.trim() !== '')
  return typeof detail === 'string' ? `：${detail}` : ''
}

function parseResponse(kind: ResponseKind, text: string, provider: string): StockApiJson {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'json': return parseJson(provider, text)
    case 'jsonp': return parseScriptPayload(provider, text, true)
    case 'script': return parseScriptPayload(provider, text, false)
    case 'html': return { content_type: 'text/html', body: text }
    case 'tencent-quotes': return parseTencentQuotes(text)
    case 'sina-quotes': return parseSinaQuotes(text)
  }
}

function parseJson(provider: string, text: string): StockApiJson {
  try {
    return toJsonValue(JSON.parse(stripBom(text)), `${provider}响应`)
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof StockApiError) throw error
    throw new StockApiError(`${provider}返回了非 JSON 数据。`)
  }
}

function parseScriptPayload(provider: string, text: string, requireJson: boolean): StockApiJson {
  const source = stripBom(text).trim().replace(/;\s*$/u, '').trim()
  const assignment = /^(?:var\s+)?[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$.]*\s*=\s*([\s\S]+)$/u.exec(source)
  const callback = /^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$.]*\s*\(\s*([\s\S]*)\s*\)$/u.exec(source)
  const payload = (assignment?.[1] ?? callback?.[1] ?? source).trim()
  try {
    return toJsonValue(JSON.parse(payload), `${provider}响应`)
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof StockApiError) throw error
    if (requireJson) throw new StockApiError(`${provider}返回了无效的 JSONP 数据。`)
    return { raw: text }
  }
}

function parseTencentQuotes(text: string): StockApiJson {
  const quotes: StockApiJson[] = []
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/(?:^|[\r\n])\s*v_([A-Za-z0-9_]+)="((?:\\.|[^"])*)";?/gu)) {
    const fields = decodeJavascriptString(match[2]).split('~')
    quotes.push({
      symbol: match[1],
      name: fields[1] ?? '',
      code: fields[2] ?? '',
      price: numericOrNull(fields[3]),
      previous_close: numericOrNull(fields[4]),
      open: numericOrNull(fields[5]),
      volume_lots: numericOrNull(fields[6]),
      market_time: fields[30] ?? '',
      change: numericOrNull(fields[31]),
      change_percent: numericOrNull(fields[32]),
      high: numericOrNull(fields[33]),
      low: numericOrNull(fields[34]),
      amount_ten_thousand_cny: numericOrNull(fields[37]),
      turnover_rate: numericOrNull(fields[38]),
      pe_ttm: numericOrNull(fields[39]),
      amplitude: numericOrNull(fields[43]),
      float_market_cap_hundred_million: numericOrNull(fields[44]),
      market_cap_hundred_million: numericOrNull(fields[45]),
      pb: numericOrNull(fields[46]),
      upper_limit: numericOrNull(fields[47]),
      lower_limit: numericOrNull(fields[48]),

function parseSinaQuotes(text: string): StockApiJson {
  const quotes: StockApiJson[] = []
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/(?:^|[\r\n])\s*var\s+hq_str_([A-Za-z0-9_]+)="((?:\\.|[^"])*)";?/gu)) {
    const fields = decodeJavascriptString(match[2]).split(',')
    const symbol = match[1]
    const aShare = /^(?:sh|sz)[0-9]{6}$/u.test(symbol)
    quotes.push({
      symbol,
      name: fields[0] ?? '',
      ...(aShare ? {
        open: numericOrNull(fields[1]),
        previous_close: numericOrNull(fields[2]),
        price: numericOrNull(fields[3]),
        high: numericOrNull(fields[4]),
        low: numericOrNull(fields[5]),
        bid: numericOrNull(fields[6]),
        ask: numericOrNull(fields[7]),
        volume_shares: numericOrNull(fields[8]),
        amount_cny: numericOrNull(fields[9]),
        date: fields[30] ?? '',
        time: fields[31] ?? '',
        status: fields[32] ?? '',
      } : {}),
      fields,
    })
  }
  if (quotes.length === 0) throw new StockApiError('新浪财经返回了无效的行情文本。')
  return { quotes }
}

function validateParameters(
  endpoint: DocumentedPublicEndpoint,
  value: unknown,
): Record<string, StockApiJson> {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new StockApiError('parameters 必须是对象。', 'bad-request')
  const descriptors: readonly StockApiParameterDescriptor[] = endpoint.parameters
  const allowed = new Map<string, StockApiParameterDescriptor>(
    descriptors.map(parameter => [parameter.name, parameter]),
  )
  const unknown = Object.keys(value).filter(key => !allowed.has(key))
  if (unknown.length > 0) {
    throw new StockApiError(`${endpoint.id} 不接受参数：${unknown.join('、')}。`, 'bad-request')
  }

  const normalized: Record<string, StockApiJson> = {}
  for (const parameter of descriptors) {
    const supplied = Object.hasOwn(value, parameter.name)
    const hasDefault = Object.hasOwn(parameter, 'default')
    if (!supplied && !hasDefault) {
      if (parameter.required) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${endpoint.id} 缺少必填参数：${parameter.name}。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      continue
    }
    const parameterValue = supplied ? value[parameter.name] : parameter.default
    normalized[parameter.name] = validateParameterValue(endpoint.id, parameter, parameterValue)
  }
  return normalized
}

function validateParameterValue(
  endpointId: string,
  parameter: StockApiParameterDescriptor,
  value: unknown,
): StockApiJson {
  const label = `${endpointId}.${parameter.name}`
  switch (parameter.type) {
    case 'string': {
      if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是字符串。`, 'bad-request')
      if (parameter.minLength !== undefined && value.length < parameter.minLength) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 不能为空。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.maxLength !== undefined && value.length > parameter.maxLength) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 长度不能超过 ${parameter.maxLength}。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.pattern !== undefined && !new RegExp(`^(?:${parameter.pattern})$`, 'u').test(value)) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 格式无效。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.enum !== undefined && !parameter.enum.includes(value)) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须为允许的枚举值。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      return value
    }
    case 'integer':
    case 'number': {
      if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || (parameter.type === 'integer' && !Number.isInteger(value))) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是${parameter.type === 'integer' ? '整数' : '有限数字'}。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.minimum !== undefined && value < parameter.minimum) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 不能小于 ${parameter.minimum}。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.maximum !== undefined && value > parameter.maximum) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 不能大于 ${parameter.maximum}。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      if (parameter.enum !== undefined && !parameter.enum.includes(value)) {
        throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须为允许的枚举值。`, 'bad-request')
      }
      return value
    }
    case 'boolean':
      if (typeof value !== 'boolean') throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是布尔值。`, 'bad-request')
      return value
    case 'array':
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是数组。`, 'bad-request')
      if (value.length > MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS) throw new StockApiError(`${label} 数组过长。`, 'bad-request')
      return value.map(item => toJsonValue(item, label))
    case 'object':
      if (!isRecord(value)) throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是对象。`, 'bad-request')
      return toJsonValue(value, label)
  }
}

function requiredMapping<T>(mapping: Readonly<Record<string, T>>, key: string, endpointId: string): T {
  const value = mapping[key]

function optionalStringParameter(parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>, name: string): string | undefined {

function integerParameter(parameters: Record<string, StockApiJson>, name: string): number {

function url(origin: string, path: string, parameters: Record<string, string | number>): string {

async function readBoundedText(
  response: Response,
  encoding: TextEncoding,
  maximum: number,
): Promise<string> {
  const contentLength = response.headers.get('content-length')
  if (contentLength !== null && Number(contentLength) > maximum) {
    try {
      await response.body?.cancel()
    } catch {
      // The size error remains authoritative.
    }
    throw new StockApiError(`上游响应超过 ${maximum} 字节限制。`)
  }

  if (response.body === null) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer())
    if (bytes.byteLength > maximum) throw new StockApiError(`上游响应超过 ${maximum} 字节限制。`)
    return new TextDecoder(encoding).decode(bytes)
  }

  const reader = response.body.getReader()
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
  let size = 0
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const item = await reader.read()
      if (item.done) break
      size += item.value.byteLength
      if (size > maximum) {
        await reader.cancel()
        throw new StockApiError(`上游响应超过 ${maximum} 字节限制。`)
      }
      chunks.push(item.value)
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock()
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size)
  let offset = 0
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes.set(chunk, offset)
    offset += chunk.byteLength
  }
  return new TextDecoder(encoding).decode(bytes)
}

function boundJson(value: StockApiJson): StockApiJson {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value.length > MAX_STRING_CHARACTERS
      ? `${value.slice(0, MAX_STRING_CHARACTERS)}\n[内容已截断]`
      : value
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length > MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS) {
      return {
        items: value.slice(0, MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS).map(boundJson),
        returned_count: MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS,
        total_count: value.length,
        truncated: true,
      }
    }
    return value.map(boundJson)
  }
  if (isRecord(value)) {
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, boundJson(item as StockApiJson)]))
  }
  return value
}

function toJsonValue(value: unknown, label: string, depth = 0): StockApiJson {
  if (depth > 32) throw new StockApiError(`${label} 嵌套层级过深。`)
  if (value === null || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean') return value
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new StockApiError(`${label} 包含非有限数字。`)
    return value
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(item => toJsonValue(item, label, depth + 1))
  if (isRecord(value)) {
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, toJsonValue(item, label, depth + 1)]))
  }
  throw new StockApiError(`${label} 必须是 JSON 值。`)
}

function stripBom(value: string): string {
  return value.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? value.slice(1) : value

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function throwIfAborted(signal: AbortSignal): void {

async function withDeadline<T>(
  signal: AbortSignal,
  timeoutMs: number,
  provider: string,
  operation: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  throwIfAborted(signal)
  const controller = new AbortController()
  let timedOut = false
  const onAbort = (): void => { controller.abort() }
  signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
  if (signal.aborted) controller.abort()
  const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timedOut = true
    controller.abort()
  }, timeoutMs)
  try {
    return await operation(controller.signal)
  } catch (error) {
    if (signal.aborted) throw new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled')
    if (timedOut) throw new StockApiError(`${provider}请求超时。`)
    throw error
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
  }
}

function sleepWithSignal(milliseconds: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
  if (signal.aborted) return Promise.reject(new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled'))
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(done, milliseconds)
    const onAbort = (): void => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      done(new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled'))
    }
    function done(error?: Error): void {
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
      if (error !== undefined) reject(error)
      else resolve()
    }
    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
  })
}

class ProviderGate {
  private active = 0
  private readonly queue: Array<() => void> = []
  private readonly startGate: StartIntervalGate

  constructor(
    private readonly maximum: number,
    minimumIntervalMs: number,
  ) {
    this.startGate = new StartIntervalGate(minimumIntervalMs)
  }

  async run<T>(
    signal: AbortSignal,
    operation: (startGate: StartIntervalGate) => Promise<T>,
  ): Promise<T> {
    await this.acquire(signal)
    try {
      return await operation(this.startGate)
    } finally {
      this.release()
    }
  }

  private async acquire(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    throwIfAborted(signal)
    if (this.active < this.maximum) {
      this.active++
      return
    }
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      let settled = false
      const resume = (): void => {
        if (settled) return
        settled = true
        signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
        this.active++
        resolve()
      }
      const cancel = (): void => {
        if (settled) return
        settled = true
        signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
        const index = this.queue.indexOf(resume)
        if (index >= 0) this.queue.splice(index, 1)
        reject(new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled'))
      }
      this.queue.push(resume)
      signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true })
      if (signal.aborted) cancel()
    })
  }

  private release(): void {
    this.active--
    this.queue.shift()?.()
  }
}

export type AbortableSleep = (
  milliseconds: number,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) => Promise<void>

/**
 * Serializes request starts without letting a cancelled queued request release
 * later requests before its predecessor has finished waiting.
 */
export class StartIntervalGate {
  private tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
  private nextStartAt = 0

  constructor(private readonly minimumIntervalMs: number) {}

  async wait(signal: AbortSignal, sleep: AbortableSleep): Promise<void> {
    throwIfAborted(signal)
    const ticket = this.tail.then(async () => {
      throwIfAborted(signal)
      const delay = Math.max(0, this.nextStartAt - Date.now())
      if (delay > 0) await sleep(delay, signal)
      throwIfAborted(signal)
      this.nextStartAt = Date.now() + this.minimumIntervalMs
    })

    // Keep the queue alive after cancellation or transport failure. The
    // caller can still stop waiting immediately through waitForSignal().
    this.tail = ticket.then(() => undefined, () => undefined)
    await waitForSignal(ticket, signal)
  }
}

function waitForSignal<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  if (signal.aborted) return Promise.reject(cancelledError())
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false
    const finish = (operation: () => void): void => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
      operation()
    }
    const onAbort = (): void => { finish(() => { reject(cancelledError()) }) }
    void promise.then(
      value => { finish(() => { resolve(value) }) },
      error => { finish(() => { reject(error) }) },
    )
    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
    if (signal.aborted) onAbort()
  })
}

function throwIfAborted(signal: AbortSignal): void {
  if (signal.aborted) throw cancelledError()
}

function cancelledError(): StockApiError {
  return new StockApiError('请求已取消。', 'cancelled')

export function marketTrendTimeRatio(time: string): number | undefined {
  const match = /(?:^|\s)(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?(?:\s|$)/u.exec(time.trim())
  if (match === null) return undefined
  const hours = Number(match[1])
  const minutes = Number(match[2])
  if (!Number.isInteger(hours) || !Number.isInteger(minutes) || hours > 23 || minutes > 59) return undefined

  const minuteOfDay = hours * 60 + minutes
  if (minuteOfDay >= MORNING_OPEN_MINUTE && minuteOfDay <= MORNING_CLOSE_MINUTE) {
    return (minuteOfDay - MORNING_OPEN_MINUTE) / MARKET_SESSION_MINUTES
  }
  if (minuteOfDay >= AFTERNOON_OPEN_MINUTE && minuteOfDay <= AFTERNOON_CLOSE_MINUTE) {
    const elapsed = MORNING_CLOSE_MINUTE - MORNING_OPEN_MINUTE + minuteOfDay - AFTERNOON_OPEN_MINUTE
    return elapsed / MARKET_SESSION_MINUTES
  }
  return undefined
}

export function marketPollingDelay(baseIntervalMs: number, consecutiveFailures: number): number {

type PollingPolicy<T> = number | undefined | ((snapshot: T | undefined) => number | undefined)

type MarketRequestRuntime = {
  policyChanged(): void
}

function useMarketRequest<T>(
  connection: ConnectionHandle,
  enabled: boolean,
  revision: number,
  pollingPolicy: PollingPolicy<T>,
  loader: MarketLoader<T>,
): RequestState<T> {
  const [state, setState] = useState<RequestState<T>>({ kind: 'loading' })
  const stateRef = useRef<RequestState<T>>(state)
  const policyRef = useRef<PollingPolicy<T>>(pollingPolicy)
  const runtimeRef = useRef<MarketRequestRuntime>()
  policyRef.current = pollingPolicy

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) {
      runtimeRef.current = undefined
      return
    }

    let active = true
    let controller: AbortController | undefined
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
    let lastStartedAt = 0
    let consecutiveFailures = 0

    const commit = (next: RequestState<T>): void => {
      stateRef.current = next
      setState(next)
    }
    const clearTimer = (): void => {
      if (timer === undefined) return
      clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = undefined
    }
    const currentInterval = (): number | undefined => {
      const policy = policyRef.current
      const snapshot = stateRef.current.kind === 'ready' ? stateRef.current.snapshot : undefined
      return typeof policy === 'function' ? policy(snapshot) : policy
    }
    const effectiveDelay = (): number | undefined => {
      const interval = currentInterval()
      if (interval === undefined) return undefined
      return marketPollingDelay(interval, consecutiveFailures)
    }
    function schedule(): void {
      clearTimer()
      if (!active || controller !== undefined || document.visibilityState === 'hidden') return
      const delay = effectiveDelay()
      if (delay === undefined) return
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        timer = undefined
        run(false)
      }, Math.max(0, delay - (Date.now() - lastStartedAt)))
    }
    function run(showLoading: boolean): void {
      if (!active || controller !== undefined) return
      const requestController = new AbortController()
      controller = requestController
      lastStartedAt = Date.now()
      if (showLoading) commit({ kind: 'loading' })

      void loader(connection, requestController.signal).then((snapshot) => {
        if (!active || requestController.signal.aborted) return
        consecutiveFailures = 0
        commit({ kind: 'ready', snapshot })
      }).catch((error: unknown) => {
        if (!active || requestController.signal.aborted) return
        consecutiveFailures++
        if (showLoading || stateRef.current.kind !== 'ready') {
          commit({ kind: 'error', message: messageOf(error) })
        }
      }).finally(() => {
        if (!active || controller !== requestController) return
        controller = undefined
        schedule()
      })
    }
    const policyChanged = (): void => {
      clearTimer()
      if (!active || controller !== undefined || document.visibilityState === 'hidden') return
      const delay = effectiveDelay()
      if (delay === undefined) return
      if (lastStartedAt === 0 || Date.now() - lastStartedAt >= delay) {
        run(stateRef.current.kind !== 'ready')
      } else {
        schedule()
      }
    }
    const onVisibilityChange = (): void => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
        clearTimer()
        const activeController = controller
        controller = undefined
        activeController?.abort()
        return
      }
      policyChanged()
    }

    const runtime = { policyChanged }
    runtimeRef.current = runtime
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
    if (document.visibilityState !== 'hidden') run(stateRef.current.kind !== 'ready')

    return () => {
      active = false
      if (runtimeRef.current === runtime) runtimeRef.current = undefined
      clearTimer()
      controller?.abort()
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
    }
  }, [connection, enabled, loader, revision])

  useEffect(() => {
    runtimeRef.current?.policyChanged()
  }, [enabled, pollingPolicy])

  return state
}

function formatUpdateTime(marketTime: string): string {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(marketTime)
  if (match === null) return `数据更新时间：${marketTime}`
  const [, , month, day, hour, minute, second] = match
  return `数据更新时间：${Number(month)}月${Number(day)}日 ${Number(hour)}时${Number(minute)}分${Number(second)}秒`
}

function IndexSparkline({
  indexName,
  trend,
  tone,
  loading,
}: {
  indexName: string
  trend: StockMarketIndexTrend | undefined
  tone: 'quoteRise' | 'quoteFall' | 'quoteFlat'
  loading: boolean
}) {
  if (trend === undefined) {
    return (
      <div className={css.sparklinePlaceholder} aria-label={`${indexName}分时${loading ? '加载中' : '暂不可用'}`}>
        {loading && <span className={css.skeleton} />}
      </div>
    )
  }

  const width = 120
  const height = 38
  const plottedPoints = trend.points.flatMap(point => {
    const timeRatio = marketTrendTimeRatio(point.time)
    return timeRatio === undefined ? [] : [{ point, x: timeRatio * width }]
  })
  if (plottedPoints.length === 0) {
    return <div className={css.sparklinePlaceholder} aria-label={`${indexName}分时暂不可用`} />
  }

  const values = [...plottedPoints.map(({ point }) => point.price), trend.previousClose]
  const minimum = Math.min(...values)
  const maximum = Math.max(...values)
  const range = maximum - minimum || Math.max(Math.abs(maximum) * 0.002, 1)
  const padding = range * 0.12
  const chartMin = minimum - padding
  const chartRange = range + padding * 2
  const yFor = (value: number): number => height - ((value - chartMin) / chartRange) * height
  const points = plottedPoints
    .map(({ point, x }) => `${x.toFixed(2)},${yFor(point.price).toFixed(2)}`)
    .join(' ')

  return (
    <svg
      className={`${css.sparkline} ${css[tone]}`}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
      preserveAspectRatio="none"
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${indexName}当日分时走势`}
    >
      <line className={css.sparklineBaseline} x1="0" x2={width} y1={yFor(trend.previousClose)} y2={yFor(trend.previousClose)} />
      <polyline className={css.sparklineLine} points={points} />
    </svg>
  )
}

  switch (ranking) {
    case 'gainers':
    case 'losers': return `${signed(stock.changePercent)}%`
    case 'netInflow':
    case 'netOutflow': return flowInHundredMillions(stock.netInflow)
  }

function flowInHundredMillions(value: number): string {
  const formatted = FLOW_FORMATTER.format(Math.abs(value) / 100_000_000)
  if (value > 0) return `+${formatted} 亿`
  if (value < 0) return `-${formatted} 亿`
  return `${formatted} 亿`
}

function toneFor(value: number): 'insightRise' | 'insightFall' | 'insightFlat' {
  if (value > 0) return 'insightRise'
  if (value < 0) return 'insightFall'
  return 'insightFlat'
}

function signed(value: number): string {
  const formatted = CHANGE_FORMATTER.format(Math.abs(value))
  if (value > 0) return `+${formatted}`
  if (value < 0) return `-${formatted}`
  return formatted
}

function formatAmountInHundredMillions(value: number): string {
  return `${AMOUNT_FORMATTER.format(Math.abs(value) / 100_000_000)}亿`
}

function latestMarketTime(indices: ReadonlyArray<StockMarketIndexQuote>): string {
  return indices.map(index => index.marketTime).sort().at(-1) ?? '--'
}

function messageOf(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : '连接行情后端失败。'

type MarketFlight = {
  controller: AbortController
  promise: Promise<RpcResult>
  settled: boolean
  waiters: number
}

class MarketRequestFlights {
  private readonly pending = new Map<MarketResourceKey, MarketFlight>()

  run(
    key: MarketResourceKey,
    signal: AbortSignal,
    operation: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<RpcResult>,
  ): Promise<RpcResult> {
    let flight = this.pending.get(key)
    if (flight === undefined) {
      const controller = new AbortController()
      const promise = Promise.resolve().then(() => operation(controller.signal))
      flight = { controller, promise, settled: false, waiters: 0 }
      this.pending.set(key, flight)
      const created = flight
      const finish = (): void => {
        created.settled = true
        if (this.pending.get(key) === created) this.pending.delete(key)
      }
      void promise.then(finish, finish)
    }
    return this.waitForFlight(flight, signal)
  }

  private waitForFlight(flight: MarketFlight, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<RpcResult> {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      if (flight.waiters === 0 && !flight.settled) flight.controller.abort()
      return Promise.resolve(cancelled())
    }

    flight.waiters++
    return new Promise<RpcResult>((resolve, reject) => {
      let finished = false
      const release = (): void => {
        if (finished) return
        finished = true
        signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
        flight.waiters--
        if (flight.waiters === 0 && !flight.settled) flight.controller.abort()
      }
      const onAbort = (): void => {
        release()
        resolve(cancelled())
      }
      signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
      if (signal.aborted) {
        onAbort()
        return
      }
      void flight.promise.then(
        value => {
          release()
          resolve(value)
        },
        error => {
          release()
          reject(error)
        },
      )
    })
  }
}

export interface StockMarketRpcOptions {
  fetcher?: typeof fetch
  now?: () => Date
  stockApiService?: StockApiService
  toolAccess?: Pick<StockToolAccessService, 'getBySessionId' | 'setBySessionId'>
  config?: StockMarketPluginConfig
  configScope?: SettingsScope<StockMarketPluginConfig>
  enabled?: boolean
}

export function registerStockMarketRpc(
  connection: HostConnectionHandle,
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions = {},
): () => Promise<void> {
  return connection.rpc.handle(
    STOCK_MARKET_RPC_CHANNEL,
    createStockMarketRpcHandler(options),
    { authority: 'trusted-host' },
  )
}

export function createStockMarketRpcHandler(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions = {},
): ConnectionRpcHandler {
  const cache: StockMarketRpcCache = {}
  const flights = new MarketRequestFlights()
  const stockApiService = options.stockApiService ?? new StockApiService({
    fetcher: options.fetcher,
    now: options.now,
  })

  return async (endpoint, payload, signal) => {
    if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()

    if (options.enabled === false
      && endpoint !== STOCK_MARKET_CONFIG_ENDPOINT
      && endpoint !== STOCK_MARKET_SET_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) {
      return unavailable('插件已关闭,仅配置可读写。')
    }
    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketConfigRequest(payload)) return badRequest('config 请求参数无效。')
      return ok({
        protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        config: options.configScope?.get() ?? options.config ?? STOCK_MARKET_DEFAULT_CONFIG,
      })
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_SET_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketSetConfigRequest(payload)) return badRequest('set-config 请求参数无效。')
      const scope = options.configScope
      if (scope === undefined) return unavailable('插件配置存储当前不可用。')
      try {
        await scope.replace(payload.config)
      } catch (error) {
        return unavailable('插件配置保存失败。')
      }
      return ok({
        protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        ok: true,
      })
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_HEALTH_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketHealthRequest(payload)) return badRequest('health 请求参数无效。')
      return {
        ok: true,
        value: {
          protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
          status: 'ready',
        },
      }
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_TOOL_ACCESS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketToolAccessRequest(payload)) return badRequest('tool-access 请求参数无效。')
      if (options.toolAccess === undefined) return unavailable('股票工具开关当前不可用。')
      try {
        return ok({
          protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
          enabled: options.toolAccess.getBySessionId(payload.sessionId),
        })
      } catch {
        return unavailable('无法读取当前会话的股票工具状态。')
      }
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_SET_TOOL_ACCESS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketSetToolAccessRequest(payload)) return badRequest('set-tool-access 请求参数无效。')
      if (options.toolAccess === undefined) return unavailable('股票工具开关当前不可用。')
      try {
        return ok({
          protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
          enabled: options.toolAccess.setBySessionId(payload.sessionId, payload.enabled),
        })
      } catch {
        return unavailable('无法更新当前会话的股票工具状态。')
      }
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_INDICES_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketIndicesRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-indices 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('indices', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketIndices(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_GLOBAL_QUOTES_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketGlobalQuotesRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-global-quotes 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('globalQuotes', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketGlobalQuotes(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_BREADTH_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketBreadthRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-breadth 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('breadth', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketBreadth(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_TRENDS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketTrendsRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-trends 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('trends', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketTrends(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_MOVERS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketMoversRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-movers 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('movers', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketMovers(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_HOTSPOTS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketHotspotsRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-hotspots 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('hotspots', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketHotspots(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_TURNOVER_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketTurnoverRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-turnover 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('turnover', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketTurnover(options, stockApiService, cache, sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_HEADLINES_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketNewsRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-headlines 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('headlines', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketNews(options, stockApiService, cache, 'headlines', sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    if (endpoint === STOCK_MARKET_FLASH_NEWS_ENDPOINT) {
      if (!isStockMarketNewsRequest(payload)) return badRequest('market-flash-news 请求参数无效。')
      return flights.run('flashNews', signal, sharedSignal => (
        marketNews(options, stockApiService, cache, 'flashNews', sharedSignal)
      ))
    }

    return badRequest(`未知的股票行情 endpoint：${JSON.stringify(endpoint)}。`)
  }
}

async function marketIndices(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.indices, 'tencent', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let quotesByCode: ReadonlyMap<string, TencentIndexQuote>
  try {
    const responseText = await stockApiService.requestTencentMarketQuotes(
      Object.values(TENCENT_INDEX_CODES),
      signal,
    )
    quotesByCode = parseTencentIndexQuotes(responseText)
  } catch {
    if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
    return unavailable('暂时无法获取指数行情。')
  }
  if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()

  const indices = STOCK_MARKET_INDICES.flatMap((index): StockMarketIndexQuote[] => {
    const quote = quotesByCode.get(TENCENT_INDEX_CODES[index.id])
    return quote === undefined ? [] : [{ id: index.id, ...quote }]
  })
  if (indices.length === 0) return unavailable('暂时无法获取指数行情。')

  const returnedIds = new Set(indices.map(index => index.id))
  const unavailableIds = STOCK_MARKET_INDICES
    .map(index => index.id)
    .filter(id => !returnedIds.has(id))
  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketIndicesResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    marketStatus: resolveMarketStatus(now, indices),
    indices,
    unavailable: unavailableIds,
  }
  cache.indices = {
    licence: 'tencent',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + TENCENT_INDICES_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketGlobalQuotes(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.globalQuotes, 'sina', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let quotes: ReadonlyArray<StockMarketGlobalQuote>
  try {
    quotes = parseSinaGlobalQuotes(await stockApiService.requestSinaGlobalQuotes(signal))
  } catch (error) {
    return marketUnavailable(signal, '暂时无法获取全球行情。', error)
  }
  if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
  if (quotes.length === 0) return unavailable('暂时无法获取全球行情。')

  const returned = new Set(quotes.map(quote => quote.id))
  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketGlobalQuotesResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    quotes,
    unavailable: STOCK_MARKET_GLOBAL_ASSETS.map(asset => asset.id).filter(id => !returned.has(id)),
  }
  cache.globalQuotes = {
    licence: 'sina',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + SINA_GLOBAL_QUOTES_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketBreadth(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.breadth, 'eastmoney', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let breadth: StockMarketBreadth
  try {
    const response = await stockApiService.executeEastMoney(
      'em_batch_quotes',
      { secids: EASTMONEY_BREADTH_SECIDS },
      signal,
    )
    const parsed = parseEastMoneyBreadth(response.data)
    if (parsed === undefined) throw new StockApiError('东方财富涨跌家数响应格式无效。')
    breadth = parsed
  } catch (error) {
    return marketUnavailable(signal, '暂时无法获取沪深涨跌家数。', error)
  }

  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketBreadthResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    breadth,
  }
  cache.breadth = {
    licence: 'eastmoney',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + EASTMONEY_BREADTH_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketTrends(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.trends, 'eastmoney', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  const results = await Promise.all(STOCK_MARKET_INDICES.map(async index => {
    try {
      const response = await stockApiService.executeEastMoney(
        'em_intraday_trends',
        { secid: EASTMONEY_INDEX_SECIDS[index.id], days: 1 },
        signal,
      )
      const trend = parseEastMoneyTrend(response.data, index.id)
      return trend === undefined ? undefined : trend
    } catch {
      return undefined
    }
  }))
  if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()

  const series = results.filter((trend): trend is StockMarketIndexTrend => trend !== undefined)
  if (series.length === 0) return unavailable('暂时无法获取指数分时走势。')
  const returnedIds = new Set(series.map(trend => trend.id))
  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketTrendsResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    series,
    unavailable: STOCK_MARKET_INDICES.map(index => index.id).filter(id => !returnedIds.has(id)),
  }
  cache.trends = {
    licence: 'eastmoney',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + EASTMONEY_TRENDS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketMovers(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.movers, 'eastmoney', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let rankings: StockMarketMoverLists
  try {
    const entries = await Promise.all(MARKET_RANKING_SPECS.map(async spec => {
      const response = await stockApiService.executeEastMoney(
        'em_market_snapshot',
        { market: 'all_a', page: 1, limit: 10, sort: spec.sort, order: spec.order },
        signal,
      )
      const rows = parseEastMoneyMovers(response.data)
      if (rows === undefined) throw new StockApiError('东方财富个股排行响应格式无效。')
      return [spec.id, rows.slice(0, STOCK_MARKET_RANKING_SUMMARY_LIMIT)] as const
    }))
    const byRanking = new Map(entries)
    rankings = {
      gainers: byRanking.get('gainers') ?? [],
      losers: byRanking.get('losers') ?? [],
      netInflow: byRanking.get('netInflow') ?? [],
      netOutflow: byRanking.get('netOutflow') ?? [],
    }
  } catch (error) {
    return marketUnavailable(signal, '暂时无法获取实时个股排行。', error)
  }

  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketMoversResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    rankings,
  }
  cache.movers = {
    licence: 'eastmoney',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + EASTMONEY_MOVERS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketHotspots(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.hotspots, 'eastmoney', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let groups: StockMarketHotspotGroups
  try {
    const entries = await Promise.all(MARKET_HOTSPOT_GROUP_IDS.map(async group => {
      const requestLimit = group === 'concept'
        ? CONCEPT_HOTSPOT_CANDIDATE_LIMIT
        : STOCK_MARKET_HOTSPOT_SUMMARY_LIMIT
      const response = await stockApiService.executeEastMoney(
        'em_market_snapshot',
        { market: group, page: 1, limit: requestLimit, sort: 'change_percent', order: 'desc' },
        signal,
      )
      const rows = parseEastMoneyHotspots(response.data)
      if (rows === undefined) throw new StockApiError('东方财富板块热点响应格式无效。')
      const visible = group === 'concept'
        ? rows.filter(quote => !isExcludedConceptHotspot(quote.name))
        : rows
      return [group, visible.slice(0, STOCK_MARKET_HOTSPOT_SUMMARY_LIMIT)] as const
    }))
    const byGroup = new Map(entries)
    groups = {
      industry: byGroup.get('industry') ?? [],
      concept: byGroup.get('concept') ?? [],
    }
  } catch (error) {
    return marketUnavailable(signal, '暂时无法获取实时板块热点。', error)
  }

  const now = currentTime(options)
  const value: StockMarketHotspotsResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: now.toISOString(),
    groups,
  }
  cache.hotspots = {
    licence: 'eastmoney',
    expiresAt: now.getTime() + EASTMONEY_HOTSPOTS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

async function marketTurnover(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache.turnover, 'tencent', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let quotes: ReadonlyMap<string, TencentIndexQuote>
  try {
    quotes = parseTencentIndexQuotes(await stockApiService.requestTencentMarketQuotes(TENCENT_TURNOVER_CODES, signal))
  } catch {
    if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
    return unavailable('暂时无法获取两市成交额。')
  }
  if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()

  const marketQuotes = TENCENT_TURNOVER_CODES.map(code => quotes.get(code))
  if (marketQuotes.some(quote => quote === undefined)) return unavailable('暂时无法获取两市成交额。')
  const availableQuotes = marketQuotes as TencentIndexQuote[]
  const tradeDates = new Set(availableQuotes.map(quote => quote.marketTime.slice(0, 10)))
  if (tradeDates.size !== 1) return unavailable('沪深市场行情日期不一致，暂时无法比较成交额。')
  const tradeDate = [...tradeDates][0]
  const marketMinute = availableQuotes
    .map(quote => quote.marketTime.slice(11, 16).replace(':', ''))
    .sort()[0]

  let history = cache.turnoverHistory
  if (history?.tradeDate !== tradeDate) {
    try {
      const daysByCode = await Promise.all(TENCENT_TURNOVER_CODES.map(async code => ({
        code,
        days: parseTencentTurnoverDays(await stockApiService.requestTencentTurnoverHistory(code, signal), code),
      })))
      history = buildTencentTurnoverHistory(tradeDate, daysByCode)
    } catch {
      if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
      return unavailable('暂时无法获取上一交易日同期成交额。')
    }
    if (history === undefined) return unavailable('暂时无法获取上一交易日同期成交额。')
    cache.turnoverHistory = history
  }

  const comparisonMinute = latestCommonMinute(history.amountsByCode, marketMinute)
  if (comparisonMinute === undefined) return unavailable('暂时无法匹配上一交易日同期成交额。')
  const previousAmounts = TENCENT_TURNOVER_CODES.map(code => history.amountsByCode.get(code)?.get(comparisonMinute))
  if (previousAmounts.some(amount => amount === undefined)) return unavailable('暂时无法匹配上一交易日同期成交额。')

  const todayAmount = availableQuotes.reduce((total, quote) => total + quote.amount, 0)
  const previousAmount = (previousAmounts as number[]).reduce((total, amount) => total + amount, 0)
  const value: StockMarketTurnoverResponse = {
    protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    fetchedAt: currentTime(options).toISOString(),
    tradeDate,
    previousTradeDate: history.previousTradeDate,
    todayAmount,
    previousAmount,
    changePercent: previousAmount > 0 ? ((todayAmount - previousAmount) / previousAmount) * 100 : 0,
  }
  cache.turnover = {
    licence: 'tencent',
    expiresAt: currentTime(options).getTime() + TENCENT_TURNOVER_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

type NewsSlot = 'headlines' | 'flashNews'

const NEWS_ENDPOINT_BY_SLOT: Record<NewsSlot, string> = {
  headlines: 'em_top_news',
  flashNews: 'em_kuaixun',
}

/** Eastmoney news needs no licence; only the service's gate + timeout apply. */
async function marketNews(
  options: StockMarketRpcOptions,
  stockApiService: StockApiService,
  cache: StockMarketRpcCache,
  slot: NewsSlot,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<RpcResult> {
  const cached = cachedSnapshot(cache[slot], '', currentTime(options))
  if (cached !== undefined) return ok(cached)

  let value: StockMarketNewsResponse
  try {
    const response = await stockApiService.executeEastMoney(
      NEWS_ENDPOINT_BY_SLOT[slot],
      { limit: STOCK_MARKET_NEWS_SUMMARY_LIMIT },
      signal,
    )
    const items = parseEastMoneyNews(response.data)
    if (items === undefined) throw new StockApiError('东方财富资讯响应格式无效。')
    value = {
      protocolVersion: STOCK_MARKET_RPC_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      fetchedAt: currentTime(options).toISOString(),
      items,
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
    return marketUnavailable(signal, slot === 'headlines' ? '暂时无法获取头条要闻。' : '暂时无法获取24小时快讯。', error)
  }

  cache[slot] = {
    licence: '',
    expiresAt: currentTime(options).getTime() + EASTMONEY_NEWS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
    value,
  }
  return ok(value)
}

function parseEastMoneyNews(value: unknown): StockMarketNewsItem[] | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !Array.isArray(value.items)) return undefined

  const items: StockMarketNewsItem[] = []
  for (const item of value.items) {
    if (!isRecord(item)) continue
    const id = typeof item.id === 'string' ? item.id.trim() : ''
    const title = typeof item.title === 'string' ? item.title.trim() : ''
    const time = typeof item.showtime === 'string'
      ? item.showtime
      : typeof item.showTime === 'string'
        ? item.showTime
        : typeof item.time === 'string'
          ? item.time
          : ''
    const summary = typeof item.digest === 'string'
      ? item.digest.trim()
      : typeof item.summary === 'string'
        ? item.summary.trim()
        : ''
    if (id.length === 0 || title.length === 0) continue
    items.push({ id, title, time, summary })
  }
  return items.length === 0 ? undefined : items.slice(0, STOCK_MARKET_NEWS_SUMMARY_LIMIT)
}

function parseEastMoneyBreadth(value: unknown): StockMarketBreadth | undefined {
  const rows = eastMoneyDiff(value)
  if (rows === undefined) return undefined

  const expectedCodes = new Set(['000001', '399001'])
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  let rising = 0
  let falling = 0
  let flat = 0
  for (const row of rows) {
    const code = typeof row.f12 === 'string' ? row.f12.trim() : ''
    if (!expectedCodes.has(code) || seen.has(code)) continue
    const rowRising = nonNegativeInteger(row.f104)
    const rowFalling = nonNegativeInteger(row.f105)
    const rowFlat = nonNegativeInteger(row.f106)
    if (rowRising === undefined || rowFalling === undefined || rowFlat === undefined) continue
    seen.add(code)
    rising += rowRising
    falling += rowFalling
    flat += rowFlat
  }
  return seen.size === expectedCodes.size ? { rising, falling, flat } : undefined
}

function parseEastMoneyTrend(value: unknown, id: StockMarketIndexId): StockMarketIndexTrend | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isRecord(value.data) || !Array.isArray(value.data.trends)) return undefined
  const previousClose = finiteNumber(value.data.preClose)
  if (previousClose === undefined || previousClose <= 0) return undefined

  const byTime = new Map<string, StockMarketTrendPoint>()
  for (const row of value.data.trends) {
    if (typeof row !== 'string') continue
    const fields = row.split(',')
    const time = fields[0]?.trim() ?? ''
    const price = finiteNumber(fields[2])
    const averagePrice = finiteNumber(fields[7]) ?? price
    if (time.length === 0 || price === undefined || price <= 0 || averagePrice === undefined || averagePrice <= 0) continue
    byTime.set(time, { time, price, averagePrice })
  }
  if (byTime.size === 0) return undefined
  return { id, previousClose, points: sampleTrendPoints([...byTime.values()]) }
}

function sampleTrendPoints(points: ReadonlyArray<StockMarketTrendPoint>): StockMarketTrendPoint[] {
  if (points.length <= STOCK_MARKET_TREND_POINT_LIMIT) return [...points]
  const lastIndex = points.length - 1
  return Array.from({ length: STOCK_MARKET_TREND_POINT_LIMIT }, (_, index) => (
    points[Math.round((index * lastIndex) / (STOCK_MARKET_TREND_POINT_LIMIT - 1))]
  ))
}

function parseEastMoneyMovers(value: unknown): StockMarketMoverQuote[] | undefined {
  const rows = eastMoneyDiff(value)
  if (rows === undefined) return undefined

  const movers = new Map<string, StockMarketMoverQuote>()
  for (const row of rows) {
    const code = typeof row.f12 === 'string' ? row.f12.trim() : ''
    const name = typeof row.f14 === 'string' ? row.f14.trim() : ''
    const price = finiteNumber(row.f2)
    const changePercent = finiteNumber(row.f3)
    const netInflow = finiteNumber(row.f62)
    if (
      !isSupportedAStockCode(code)
      || name.length === 0
      || price === undefined
      || changePercent === undefined
      || netInflow === undefined
    ) continue
    movers.set(code, {
      code,
      name,
      price,
      changePercent,
      netInflow,
    })
  }
  return movers.size === 0 ? undefined : [...movers.values()]
}

function parseEastMoneyHotspots(value: unknown): StockMarketHotspotQuote[] | undefined {
  const rows = eastMoneyDiff(value)
  if (rows === undefined) return undefined

  const hotspots = new Map<string, StockMarketHotspotQuote>()
  for (const row of rows) {
    const code = typeof row.f12 === 'string' ? row.f12.trim() : ''
    const name = typeof row.f14 === 'string' ? row.f14.trim() : ''
    const changePercent = finiteNumber(row.f3)
    if (code.length === 0 || code.length > 32 || name.length === 0 || changePercent === undefined) continue
    hotspots.set(code, { code, name, changePercent })
  }
  if (rows.length === 0) return []
  return hotspots.size === 0 ? undefined : [...hotspots.values()]
}

function isExcludedConceptHotspot(name: string): boolean {
  return CONCEPT_HOTSPOT_EXCLUDED_KEYWORDS.some(keyword => name.includes(keyword))
}

function eastMoneyDiff(value: unknown): ReadonlyArray<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isRecord(value.data) || !Array.isArray(value.data.diff)) return undefined
  return value.data.diff.filter(isRecord)
}

function resolveMarketStatus(
  now: Date,
  indices: ReadonlyArray<StockMarketIndexQuote>,
): StockMarketTradingStatus {
  const clock = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hourCycle: 'h23',
    weekday: 'short',
  }).formatToParts(now)
  const part = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes): string => clock.find(item => item.type === type)?.value ?? ''
  const today = `${part('year')}-${part('month')}-${part('day')}`
  const latestTradeDate = indices.map(index => index.marketTime.slice(0, 10)).sort().at(-1)
  const weekday = part('weekday')
  if (latestTradeDate !== today || weekday === 'Sat' || weekday === 'Sun') return 'closed'

  const minutes = Number(part('hour')) * 60 + Number(part('minute'))
  if (minutes < 9 * 60 + 15) return 'preopen'
  if (minutes < 9 * 60 + 30) return 'auction'
  if (minutes < 11 * 60 + 30) return 'trading'
  if (minutes < 13 * 60) return 'break'
  if (minutes < 15 * 60) return 'trading'
  return 'closed'
}

function nonNegativeInteger(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  const numeric = finiteNumber(value)
  return numeric !== undefined && Number.isSafeInteger(numeric) && numeric >= 0 ? numeric : undefined
}

type TencentTurnoverDay = {
  tradeDate: string
  amountsByMinute: ReadonlyMap<string, number>
}

function parseTencentTurnoverDays(value: unknown, code: string): TencentTurnoverDay[] {
  if (!isRecord(value) || value.code !== 0 || !isRecord(value.data)) return []
  const market = value.data[code]
  if (!isRecord(market) || !Array.isArray(market.data)) return []

  const days: TencentTurnoverDay[] = []
  for (const item of market.data) {
    if (!isRecord(item) || !Array.isArray(item.data)) continue
    const tradeDate = dateText(item.date)
    if (tradeDate === undefined) continue

    const amountsByMinute = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const row of item.data) {
      if (typeof row !== 'string') continue
      const fields = row.trim().split(/\s+/)
      const minute = fields[0]
      const amount = finiteNumber(fields[3])
      if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(minute) || amount === undefined || amount < 0) continue
      amountsByMinute.set(minute, amount)
    }
    if (amountsByMinute.size > 0) days.push({ tradeDate, amountsByMinute })
  }
  return days
}

function buildTencentTurnoverHistory(
  tradeDate: string,
  series: ReadonlyArray<{ code: string; days: ReadonlyArray<TencentTurnoverDay> }>,
): TencentTurnoverHistory | undefined {
  if (series.length === 0 || series.some(item => item.days.length === 0)) return undefined
  const datesByCode = series.map(item => new Map(item.days.map(day => [day.tradeDate, day] as const)))
  const previousTradeDate = [...datesByCode[0].keys()]
    .filter(date => date < tradeDate && datesByCode.every(days => days.has(date)))
    .sort()
    .at(-1)
  if (previousTradeDate === undefined) return undefined

  const amountsByCode = new Map<string, ReadonlyMap<string, number>>()
  for (const [position, item] of series.entries()) {
    const day = datesByCode[position].get(previousTradeDate)
    if (day === undefined) return undefined
    amountsByCode.set(item.code, day.amountsByMinute)
  }
  return { tradeDate, previousTradeDate, amountsByCode }
}

function latestCommonMinute(
  amountsByCode: ReadonlyMap<string, ReadonlyMap<string, number>>,
  targetMinute: string,
): string | undefined {
  const series = [...amountsByCode.values()]
  if (series.length === 0) return undefined
  return [...series[0].keys()]
    .filter(minute => minute <= targetMinute && series.every(amounts => amounts.has(minute)))
    .sort()
    .at(-1)
}

function dateText(value: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return undefined
  const match = /^(\d{4})[-/]?(\d{2})[-/]?(\d{2})/.exec(value.trim())
  return match === null ? undefined : `${match[1]}-${match[2]}-${match[3]}`
}

function parseSinaGlobalQuotes(value: unknown): ReadonlyArray<StockMarketGlobalQuote> {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !Array.isArray(value.quotes)) return []
  const rows = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>()
  for (const candidate of value.quotes) {
    if (!isRecord(candidate) || typeof candidate.symbol !== 'string') continue
    rows.set(candidate.symbol, candidate)
  }
  return STOCK_MARKET_GLOBAL_ASSETS.flatMap((asset): StockMarketGlobalQuote[] => {
    const row = rows.get(SINA_GLOBAL_ASSET_SYMBOLS[asset.id])
    const quote = row === undefined ? undefined : parseSinaGlobalQuote(asset.id, row)
    return quote === undefined ? [] : [quote]
  })
}

function parseSinaGlobalQuote(
  id: StockMarketGlobalAssetId,
  row: Record<string, unknown>,
): StockMarketGlobalQuote | undefined {
  if (id === 'sse') {
    return globalQuote(
      id,
      row.price,
      row.previous_close,
      row.open,
      row.high,
      row.low,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      marketTime(row.date, row.time),
    )
  }
  if (id === 'hangSeng' || id === 'nasdaq') {
    const price = fieldAt(row, 1)
    const change = fieldAt(row, 2)
    return globalQuote(
      id,
      price,
      previousCloseFromChange(price, change),
      null,
      null,
      null,
      change,
      fieldAt(row, 3),
      '',
    )
  }
  if (id === 'kospi' || id === 'nikkei') {
    return globalQuote(
      id,
      fieldAt(row, 1),
      fieldAt(row, 9),
      fieldAt(row, 8),
      fieldAt(row, 10),
      fieldAt(row, 11),
      fieldAt(row, 2),
      fieldAt(row, 3),
      marketTime(fieldAt(row, 6), fieldAt(row, 7)),
    )
  }
  return globalQuote(
    id,
    fieldAt(row, 0),
    fieldAt(row, 7),
    fieldAt(row, 8),
    fieldAt(row, 4),
    fieldAt(row, 5),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    marketTime(fieldAt(row, 12), fieldAt(row, 6)),
  )
}

function globalQuote(
  id: StockMarketGlobalAssetId,
  priceValue: unknown,
  previousCloseValue: unknown,
  openValue: unknown,
  highValue: unknown,
  lowValue: unknown,
  changeValue: unknown,
  changePercentValue: unknown,
  quoteTime: string,
): StockMarketGlobalQuote | undefined {
  const price = positiveNumber(priceValue)
  if (price === undefined) return undefined
  const previousClose = nullablePositiveNumber(previousCloseValue)
  const change = finiteNumber(changeValue)
    ?? (previousClose === null ? undefined : rounded(price - previousClose))
  const changePercent = finiteNumber(changePercentValue)
    ?? (previousClose === null ? undefined : rounded((change ?? 0) / previousClose * 100))
  if (change === undefined || changePercent === undefined) return undefined
  return {
    id,
    price,
    previousClose,
    open: nullablePositiveNumber(openValue),
    high: nullablePositiveNumber(highValue),
    low: nullablePositiveNumber(lowValue),
    change,
    changePercent,
    marketTime: quoteTime,
  }
}

function fieldAt(row: Record<string, unknown>, index: number): unknown {
  return Array.isArray(row.fields) ? row.fields[index] : undefined
}

function previousCloseFromChange(priceValue: unknown, changeValue: unknown): number | null {
  const price = positiveNumber(priceValue)
  const change = finiteNumber(changeValue)
  if (price === undefined || change === undefined) return null
  return nullablePositiveNumber(rounded(price - change))
}

function marketTime(dateValue: unknown, timeValue: unknown): string {
  return [dateValue, timeValue]
    .filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0)
    .map(value => value.trim())
    .join(' ')
}

function rounded(value: number): number {
  return Number(value.toFixed(6))
}

function positiveNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  const numeric = finiteNumber(value)
  return numeric !== undefined && numeric > 0 ? numeric : undefined
}

function nullablePositiveNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  return positiveNumber(value) ?? null
}

function parseTencentIndexQuotes(value: string): ReadonlyMap<string, TencentIndexQuote> {
  const quotes = new Map<string, TencentIndexQuote>()
  const assignments = value.matchAll(/(?:^|[\r\n])\s*v_([a-z0-9]+)="([^"]*)";?/g)
  for (const assignment of assignments) {
    const quote = parseTencentIndexQuote(assignment[2])
    if (quote !== undefined) quotes.set(assignment[1], quote)
  }
  return quotes
}

function parseTencentIndexQuote(value: string): TencentIndexQuote | undefined {
  const fields = value.split('~')
  const price = finiteNumber(fields[3])
  const previousClose = finiteNumber(fields[4])
  const open = finiteNumber(fields[5])
  const change = finiteNumber(fields[31])
  const changePercent = finiteNumber(fields[32])
  const high = finiteNumber(fields[33])
  const low = finiteNumber(fields[34])
  const preciseAmount = finiteNumber(fields[35]?.split('/')[2])
  const amountInTenThousands = finiteNumber(fields[37])
  const amount = preciseAmount ?? (amountInTenThousands === undefined ? undefined : amountInTenThousands * 10_000)
  const marketTime = formatTencentMarketTime(fields[30])
  if (
    price === undefined
    || previousClose === undefined
    || open === undefined
    || high === undefined
    || low === undefined
    || change === undefined
    || changePercent === undefined
    || amount === undefined
    || amount < 0
    || marketTime === undefined
  ) return undefined

  return { price, previousClose, open, high, low, change, changePercent, amount, marketTime }
}

function formatTencentMarketTime(value: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const match = /^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/.exec(value ?? '')
  if (match === null) return undefined
  return `${match[1]}-${match[2]}-${match[3]} ${match[4]}:${match[5]}:${match[6]}`
}

function isSupportedAStockCode(value: string): boolean {
  return /^(?:000|001|002|003|300|301|600|601|603|605|688)\d{3}$/.test(value)
}

function marketUnavailable(signal: AbortSignal, fallback: string, error?: unknown): RpcResult {
  if (signal.aborted) return cancelled()
  if (error instanceof StockApiError && error.kind === 'unavailable') return unavailable(error.message)
  return unavailable(fallback)
}

function cachedSnapshot<T>(
  cache: SnapshotCache<T> | undefined,
  licence: string,
  now: Date,
): T | undefined {
  if (cache === undefined || cache.licence !== licence || cache.expiresAt <= now.getTime()) return undefined
  return cache.value
}

function currentTime(options: StockMarketRpcOptions): Date {
  return (options.now ?? (() => new Date()))()
}

function ok(value: unknown): RpcResult {
  return { ok: true, value } as RpcResult
}

function finiteNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number'
    ? value
    : typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== ''
      ? Number(value)
      : Number.NaN
  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : undefined
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function badRequest(message: string): RpcResult {
  return {
    ok: false,
    error: {
      code: 'bad-request',
      message,
      details: { issues: [] },
    },
  } as RpcResult
}

function unavailable(message: string): RpcResult {
  return {
    ok: false,
    error: {
      code: 'internal',
      message,
      details: {},
    },
  } as RpcResult
}

function cancelled(): RpcResult {
  return {
    ok: false,
    error: {
      code: 'cancelled',
      message: '请求已取消。',
      details: {},
    },
  } as RpcResult
}
